jobs.title: Project Manager (UK)
jobs.description:
### **About the company**


**What’s Promptly in a nutshell**


Promptly is building the first patient\-centered global evidence network, offering real world data sharing and monetization capabilities. Together with a selected network of Partners, we generate new knowledge from harmonized datasets, augmented with the collection of longitudinal patient\-reported data and patient\-generated digital biomarkers within a secure and privacy\-preserving environment.


We answer the question – is this patient treatment the best it could possibly be?

  

  

**What’s our purpose**


We exist to empower every patient and every health organization on the planet with evidence on the outcomes of care!


Why do we get up in the morning? Well, most healthcare professionals have chosen to work in healthcare driven by their desire to make a difference in patients’ lives. And so have we! We have chosen to follow this calling by addressing the biggest problem in healthcare: the lack of real\-world evidence on the outcomes of care.


For us, society denying patients better care due to lack of access to data is unethical, in a world where technology improved so many aspects of our world. Making the right evidence available to healthcare organizations to help prevent one lost life, one care complication, one failed treatment is the moral obligation that big tech companies have – it’s our Hippocratic Oath.


At Promptly, everything we do is driven by our core purpose: to promote better healthcare at lower costs for patients every day, by making health outcomes available.


### **About the role**


As a Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in leading and coordinating a dedicated project that brings together patients, healthcare professionals, and technology teams. You will be responsible for the successful planning, execution, and delivery of initiatives across a federated health data programme. Acting as the bridge between business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable impact.


This role requires strong project management expertise combined with sharp stakeholder management skills and a structured, delivery\-oriented mindset. You do not need a technical background, but you must be comfortable navigating complex, multi\-stakeholder environments in the health technology sector.


**What you’ll be expected to do (Key responsibilities)**


*Project planning \& delivery*


* Define and manage project scope, objectives, timelines, and success metrics.
* Create and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, and resource allocations.
* Develop and track deliverables and milestones across workstreams involving patients, clinicians, and business stakeholders.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to agreed quality standards.
* Monitor budgets and financial performance, flagging deviations proactively.
  

  

*Stakeholder management \& communication*


* Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams, external partners, and user groups.
* Manage relationships with sponsors, executives, external collaborators, and patient and professional user groups.
* Translate complex requirements into clear, actionable plans and communications.
* Provide regular updates, presentations, and executive\-level reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Ensure continuous alignment between business objectives and delivery realities.
  

  

*Team leadership \& collaboration*


* Coordinate cross\-functional teams, ensuring accountability and collaboration across clinical, product, and business groups.
* Establish working methodologies, governance structures, and escalation paths.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports co\-creation and continuous improvement.
  

  

*Risk \& issue management*


* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks proactively.
* Maintain issue logs, track dependencies, and implement corrective actions.
* Escalate blockers and decisions with appropriate context and recommendations.
  

  

*Process \& tools*


* Utilise project management tools such as Jira to maintain visibility and control.
* Drive continuous improvement in project delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches).
* Contribute to customer success initiatives, supporting onboarding, adoption, and sustained value creation.
  

  

**What we’re looking for (qualifications \& skills)**


**Education \& certification**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Healthcare, or a related field.
* Professional certification in Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA) or Agile methodologies is a strong advantage, though not required.
  

  

**Experience**


* Minimum 5 years of proven experience in project management roles.
* Experience delivering projects in healthcare, digital health, or data\-driven environments is strongly preferred.
* Track record of managing cross\-functional or multi\-stakeholder teams across clinical, business, and technical groups.
* Demonstrated ability to manage executive\-level communication and reporting.
  

  

**Core skills**


* Exceptional communication, stakeholder engagement, and negotiation skills.
* Strong organisational and planning capabilities, with excellent attention to detail.
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset with a delivery\-oriented approach.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environments.
* Comfortable engaging with technical teams and translating outputs into business language, without needing to be technical yourself.
  

  

**Position**


* Location: Remote (Europe based)
* Type: Full\-time
* Travel: Occasional in\-person meetings across the UK
  

  

**What we offer**


**Ownership \& Growth**


* Define and own a strategic global initiative from the ground up
* Shape the future of Promptly’s partner ecosystem and data network expansion
  

  

**Financial Benefits**


* Competitive salary
* Annual perfo

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a driven Project Manager/Delivery Lead to work on the Contact Center Solutions Technology team. This team enables the rest of our associates in Contact Center Operations carry out its mission in serving our patients. A Project Manager/Delivery Lead, is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivery of defined deliverables as part of a larger program and almost always requires engagement from multiple teams. Key responsibilities include communicating the work objectives, coordinating delivery, managing risks, ensuring compliance to standards, and providing end\-to\-end visibility into the health of the deliverables. This role ensures execution and delivery meets or exceeds the client’s expectations in terms of the functionality, quality, timeline, and cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

* You will form teams, kick off projects and coordinate and facilitate routines to support delivery – e.g. status reviews, stakeholder meetings, change controls etc.
* You will shape the final product working with our Business Owners and teams. You will build resilient, supportable technology systems. And as part of that you will make plans and coordinate delivery and dependencies with across multiple teams.
* You will recognize, anticipate, and facilitate dependency management, risk management. You will remove impediments or know who to call and help remove.
* You will actively promote communication and collaboration across organizations to support the deliverable completion and timeline. You will think local (your team) and think global (AEI) and you will manage those two sometimes competing interests.
* You will lead delivery of technical sections of requirements as well as design, traceability matrix, deployment tasks and contingency/rollback plans.
* Software changes are done well but should also be documented well. You understand what "Change Management" means you ensure deliverables comply with Enterprise Change Management standards.
* You will provide status updates for the deliverables to stakeholders and leadership pertaining to delivery, risks/issues, and schedule.
* You will ensure that execution is aligned with deliverable requirements by working with the Business.
* You will support resource planning, manage the resource pipeline, recognize skill deficits, resource bottlenecks and help alleviate them.
* You will be the resource Management, Scrum Master for the Contact Center Solutions Dev team.

**Required Skills**

Bachelor’s Degree with 6 years’ experience in Business Information Services, or Computer Sciences preferred.

* Proven experience in Project Management, Planning, Estimation and Execution.
* Good understanding of Change Management and modern tools used for that purpose \- ServiceNow, JIRA etc.
* Ability to communicate complexity to an audience by tailoring the message.
* You will have an “ownership” mindset and are used to taking collective responsibility for every decision, owning, and managing errors and finding the right way.
* Demonstrate mature judgement in dealing with ambiguity and complexity and can demonstrate balancing enterprise needs over individual program’s
* Ability to handle multiple, competing priorities. There will always be things competing for your mindshare.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to solicit input from others.
* You will be part of a team that lives and breathes Agile and believes in The Manifesto. You understand Agile development and get it like driving on the road. Agile frameworks work alongside cultural values, and you have the cultural background.
* Ability to manage and prioritize the work of others, directly and indirectly working for you.
* Ability to talk to executives and develop presentation material. You understand the BLOT principle \- Bottom Line On Top.
* Persistence, poise, and perseverance to get things accomplished.
* Proven experience in project managing contact center automation and conversational AI initiatives, overseeing cross\-functional teams, enterprise integrations, solution performance monitoring, and continuous optimization to improve customer experience and achieve business outcomes.
* Understands project forecasting and managing project budgets, and PO’s across multiple service providing teams.
* Ability to be hands\-on. Not necessarily write code but you are close enough to technology to be able to guide, discern between competing technical solutions and make choices.
* Very good Excel skills – pivots, charting etc. is often helpful.
* At least 3\-5 years Contact Center experience.
* PMP certification.

Pay: $65\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: EverPro - Project Manager III
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

  

  

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/  



  

**EverPro,** a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose\-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long\-term growth.


Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

  

  

We are looking for a Project Manager to focus on our Bold Group Product. The Security \& Alarm division of EverCommerce serves the electronic security industry with the most comprehensive array of alarm monitoring and integrated financial management solutions tailored to achieve optimal business performance. Bold Group's product portfolio features the renowned alarm monitoring systems Manitou, stages®, and SIMS. These leading alarm monitoring systems are complemented by the industry's top accounting and business management systems: the SedonaOffice suite and the award\-winning Managely system. The Project Manager works with the customer and various technical resources; including Application consultants, Technical Consultants, and other resources to ensure the accuracy and success of each project. This position requires a high\-level of customer interaction, the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, and the tenacity to drive projects to completion.

  

  

We are looking for an individual with a strong work ethic and thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative setting. You're a critical thinker who possesses strong organizational and communication skills, including the ability to connect authentically with people via the phone and email. This position manages the development, resolution, and delivery of various digital projects from start to finish. Because of this, you love prioritizing initiatives, tracking impact, and occasionally putting out fires. On the strength's spectrum, you are well rounded between executing, influencing, relationship building, and strategic thinking.

  

  

**Responsibilities**


* Coordinate and schedule project tasks with the appropriate resources
* Drive implementation to completion within timeline
* Establish internal and external expectations and accountability
* Effectively prioritize and update tasks for implementation projects
* Communicate with all departments to ensure needs are addressed and timelines are met
* Progress implementation projects according to project details
* Track, document, and finalize projects in alignment with company processes
* Provide support to customers for project\-related questions and ensure timely and reliable response
* Provide effective leadership, direction and consistent communication to technical resources
* Utilize TaskRay, Microsoft Excel, Project, or other project management software applications to track projects
* Participate in ongoing training and professional development
* Salesforce experience preferred
  

  

**Skills and Experience Needed for Success in This Role**


* PMP certification desired
* 7\+ years of successful project management in SaaS Software
* Knowledge of business application processes, ERP software and accounting practices desired
* Detail\-oriented and organized with a pro\-active attitude
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong project management skills
* Effective verbal and written communication skills
* Able to navigate standard office software without difficulty
* Capable of independently seeking information and working with a sense of urgency in a fast\-paced environment
  

  

**Where: Remote, US**


The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you're close to one of our offices, we can set you up in\-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. Please note that this role requires eligibility to work in the U.S. and may require travel.

jobs.title: Research Project Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.


Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.


**Job description**
===================


We are looking for a Research Project Manager to join Oura’s Research Operations team, supporting strategic partnership projects generating real\-world evidence of Oura’s impact and utility across health domains and populations. This role will own multiple outcomes\-focused research projects and coordinate closely with Clinical Outcomes, Health Science, Data Science, Engineering, Product, Commercial, Legal, Regulatory, and external partners.We have offices in San Francisco, San Diego and Los Angeles for those who prefer hybrid or office settings. Oura employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co\-working locations.


### **What You Will Do:**


* Own a portfolio of commercial, academic, and member\-based research studies, from feasibility and scoping through partner coordination, launch, data collection, analysis readiness, reporting, and closeout.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic collaborators in academic, healthcare, CRO, and commercial organizations.
* Establish repeatable processes, workflows, and documentation to enable high\-quality research at industry speed and scale in a highly dynamic environment.
* Work with teams of experts to translate research questions into clear study plans, operational requirements, documented decisions, milestones, reporting, and evidence deliverables.
* Coordinate budgets, contracts, partner responsibilities, data\-transfer expectations, privacy and consent requirements, timelines, and issue resolution.
* Monitor study progress, surface risks early, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Support evidence dissemination through reports, publications, abstracts, partner deliverables, clinical education, or commercial and regulatory materials as appropriate.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based on the East Coast.


### **What you'll bring**


* 3\+ years of experience managing human research, clinical research, health outcomes, real\-world evidence, healthcare programs, or equivalent partner research programs.
* Experience independently managing external academic, commercial, clinical, CRO, and/or healthcare partnerships.
* Experience taking research or outcomes projects from feasibility and planning through execution, reporting, and closeout.
* Strong project\-management, documentation, risk\-management, and cross\-functional communication skills.
* Familiarity with research data flows, participant privacy and consent, data\-quality review, and tools such as spreadsheets, project trackers, survey platforms, EHRs, EDC, CTMS, eTMF, or comparable systems.
* Human\-subjects research and GCP/CITI training, or willingness to complete required training.

Merchant Boarding \& Business Services – POS

POS Manager, Professional Services
**About Payroc**
  

  

Payroc is a global payments technology company helping businesses get paid, grow faster, and operate smarter. From powerful POS systems to seamless online and mobile payment solutions, we equip merchants with the tools they need to succeed in today’s fast\-moving commerce landscape.
At Payroc, our culture is built around people who lead with grit, take ownership, and are not afraid to be a boss when it comes to driving results. We believe the best solutions start when we listen first to our customers, our partners, and each other so we can deliver payment experiences that truly make a difference for the businesses we serve.
We are a team that moves quickly, thinks entrepreneurially, and celebrates big wins together. If you are energized by building relationships, solving real business problems, and creating opportunities for yourself and your clients, Payroc is the kind of place where you can make an impact and grow your career.
**Position Overview**
  

  

The POS Project Manager is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role that goes beyond traditional project management by actively overseeing and supporting the installation, configuration, and deployment of POS and payment solutions. Serving as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation lifecycle, this individual coordinates project timelines, manages cross\-functional teams, and works directly with merchants to ensure a seamless onboarding and successful go\-live.

We are seeking a Deputy Program Manager to coordinate day\-to\-day delivery of Army Finance modernization based on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F\&O), including Finance and Supply Chain Management. The deputy will support the Program Manager across delivery teams, partners, staffing, schedules, and Government reviews, exercise delegated management authority, and maintain continuity as the program advances through implementation, migration, and deployment milestones.

* Maintain visibility into staffing, resource forecasts, subcontractor commitments, and workload needs; escalate gaps and coordinate corrective actions.

jobs.title: Senior Program Analyst / Schedule Architect
jobs.description:
**About Blue Water Thinking**



Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer\-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.



Founded by a decorated twenty\-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.



Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one\-team" approach and brings to bear best\-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.



Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.



Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long\-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

**Job Description:**



Blue Water Thinking is seeking an experienced and dedicated Senior Program Analyst to serve as Schedule Architect and P6 Migration Lead, supporting the Integrated Healthcare Transformation (IHT) initiative at the Department of Veterans Affairs HEFP SEP program. The role carries three linked mandates: architect the target Primavera P6 enterprise environment that a 1,100\+ project portfolio can sustain; map legacy data into logic\-driven schedules without loss of existing data or functionality; and support federal program managers and field staff through the change, with adoption as a key deliverable. All work is advisory; final decision\-making authority rests with the Government, and the incumbent does not draft procurement documents or perform inherently governmental functions.


**Responsibilities:**


***Migration Architecture and Data Mapping***  

* Assess the legacy Microsoft Project Web Access environment and produce a defensible mapping of every legacy data element to its P6 destination, including activity codes, user\-defined fields, WBS levels, calendars, or planned retirement, with rationale documented and Government\-approved.
* Design the enterprise architecture, including EPS hierarchy, WBS standards, activity coding dictionary, calendar library, and UDF strategy sized for portfolio\-scale reporting.
* Develop standardized fragnets and schedule templates by project archetype, including telecommunications room cutovers, data center relocations, elevator modernization, AHU/chiller replacement, and roof replacement.
* Convert milestone\-dominant legacy records into activities with durations and logic while preserving genuine milestones and maintaining legacy reporting during parallel operations until the Government accepts the new reporting.
* Establish and routinely report schedule health criteria, including open ends, negative lag, constraint use, out\-of\-sequence progress, excessive float, and missing predecessors or successors.

***Master Schedule Development, Integration, and Variance Analysis***  

* Build and manage master schedules with full traceability of program and project milestones defined by SEP federal program managers.
* Maintain schedule baselines, control baseline changes, and preserve audit trails of schedule revisions.
* Manage schedule data across design and construction projects spanning EHRM, recapitalization, and targeted infrastructure portfolios.
* Align the EHRM NRM Capital Integrated Schedule with the EHRMIO Integrated Master Schedule and coordinate with Oracle Health and VA stakeholders, including EHRMIO, OIT, OCFM, OAEM, and PCAC.
* Coordinate with VISN and VAMC engineering staff, site engineers, design and A/E firms, and general contractors to gather schedule events and establish dependencies.
* Analyze schedule data for critical path impact, downstream program effects, and schedule variance across deployment sites.
* Identify, quantify, and escalate schedule risks and support maintenance of the SEP risk register using recognized program risk management techniques.

***Coaching, Reporting, and Adoption***  

* Coach and mentor federal program managers, SEP lead engineers, and field staff on schedule interpretation, including critical path, float, milestone movement, and overall program impacts.
* Develop training aids, job aids, bulletins, quick\-reference guides, and SOPs, and provide recurring instruction through office hours, working sessions, recorded walkthroughs, and cohort training.
* Build and maintain Power BI and SharePoint reporting views that present P6 data in accessible terms and monitor adoption to identify areas requiring additional support or design improvements.
* Produce the weekly Capital Integrated Schedule and Risk/Event Report, support Capital Schedule and Variance Reports, and develop executive reporting showing milestone status and variance in clear, non\-technical language.

**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Must have previous federal government experience or experience working for a federal contractor.
* 8\+ years of professional scheduling experience supporting design and construction or capital infrastructure programs, including at least 3 years at a senior or lead level within a multi\-project portfolio.
* Demonstrated experience converting a milestone\-based, spreadsheet\-based, or tracking\-register system into a logic\-driven CPM schedule, including responsibility for data mapping and conversion decisions.
* Expert\-level experience with Oracle Primavera P6 Professional and EPPM

Whether you're in our U.S.\-based offices supporting refugees, asylees or unaccompanied children ... implementing hygiene initiatives in Cambodia or rebuilding projects in Central America ... or even connecting remotely from your home on fundraising campaigns, grant reports, or critical communications \- you have the opportunity to work towards a world where everyone has food, a voice and a safe place to call home.
Responsibilities:

Core Duties  

Program Management* Responsible for meeting program goals, client enrollments, and job placements as established by the contract guidelines.
* Monitor general client well\-being and conduct random sample reviews of client case notes and case files to ensure quality and timeliness of service provision and fulfillment of documentation requirements.
* Ensure coordination among the different components of programming and community partners.
* Stay up to date on program changes, best practices and funder requirements.
* Ensure professionalism and quality employment service provision. Provide ongoing training to staff on program developments and service requirements.

  

People Management
* Recruit, hire, train, supervise, and evaluate staff in accordance with CWS personnel policies and guidance from CWS Human Resources.
* Promote teamwork, coordinate the workload of staff, delegate responsibilities, and hold staff accountable.
* Provide ongoing training to staff on program developments and service requirements.
* Develop trainings which include a detailed explanation of program services, including but not limited to; acculturation, adult education, employment, mentoring/youth services and immigration legal services.
* Promote teamwork, coordinate the workload of staff, delegate responsibilities, and hold staff accountable.

  

Grants, Reporting, and Compliance
* Coordinate and manage all aspects of the program including contract compliance, workflow coordination, quality control and the enhancements of services.
* Monitor compliance of programs with program requirement and CWS guidelines and procedures
* Complete required funder reports, coordinating with team members to ensure proper tracking and reporting of activities.
* Prepare for and participate in on\-site monitoring visits with leadership teams.

  

Partnerships and Development
* Develop partnerships with local providers, volunteers, mentors and community organizations that support program goals and client needs
* Present programs to employers, local school districts, state health clinics, state refugee coordinator’s offices, medical providers, and other relevant service providers
* Participate in meetings on the national, state, and local levels, including those with services of stakeholders, other VOLAGS, and colleague agencies.
* Record clients’ progress in case files and master trackers, including compliance, job offers, placements, job retention, public assistance usage, follow\-up on placements, and possibilities of upgrades.
* Address emergency situations as they arise and mediate conflict as necessary

  


Qualifications:
*Education:** Bachelor's degree in social work, human services, sociology, psychology, public administration, public health, or a related field or equivalent experience in lieu of degree.

 *Experience:** Minimum 6 years of previous work experience in refugee or immigrant\-related services.
* Minimum 2 years of previous demonstrated work experience supervising others.
* Experience in a local resettlement affiliate or a national office of a resettlement agency (preferred)
* Experience in social services or nonprofit sectors (preferred).

 *Skills:*
* Strong interpersonal and diplomacy skills; ability to work collaboratively and effectively with partners and teams;
* Strong attention to detail a must
* Ability to always conduct oneself in a professional and courteous manner to represent the professional and institutional interests of CWS;
* Strong knowledge and experience in working with Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and database software is essential;
* Strong writing skills are required.
* The ability to work in a multi\-cultural environment is required.

  


Benefits : CWS offers a competitive benefits package that includes: \- 403 (b) Retirement Plan \- Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance \- Generous Paid Time Off (18 Paid Days Off; 24 Days after 2 Years) \- 14 Official Holidays \- 12 Sick Days Off (Accrued monthly) \- Life Insurance and AD\&D \- Long Term and Short\-Term Disability \- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) \- Health Savings Account \- Flexible Spending Accounts

jobs.title: Life Sciences - Reinvention Program Manager
jobs.description:
We are:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
* This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI\-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

  

The Work:

* Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy \& Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
* Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
* Leverage AI\-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
* Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
* Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast\-moving transformation engagement

  

You are:


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.


  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

  

* Program or project management at a top\-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi\-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
* A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Strong executive\-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision\-ready materials.
* Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

  

Preferred skills/experience:

  

* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMP, Agile/Scrum (CSM, SAFe), or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience managing AI\-enabled transformation programs or enterprise change initiatives in Life Sciences.
* Familiarity with AI agent orchestration tools for program reporting, status automation, or backlog management.
* Track record at a top\-tier consulting firm managing large\-scale transformation program delivery across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. **Description**


**JOB TITLE:**  

Procurement Manager (TC) **DEPT/DIV:**  

Procurement **SUPERVISOR:**Director of Procurement **WORK LOCATION:**  

333 West 34th Street, New York, NY 10001 **HOURS OF WORK:**  

8:00 am \- 4:30 pm (7\.5 hours/day, or as required) **FULL/PART\-TIME**  

FULL **SALARY RANGE:**  

$103,876 \- $115,418 **DEADLINE:**  

Until filled  


This position is eligible for telework, which is currently one day per week. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.

**Opening:**


The Metropolitan Transportation Authority is North America's largest transportation network, serving a population of 15\.3 million people across a 5,000\-square\-mile travel area surrounding New York City, Long Island, southeastern New York State, and Connecticut. The MTA network comprises the nation’s largest bus fleet and more subway and commuter rail cars than all other U.S. transit systems combined. MTA strives to provide a safe and reliable commute, excellent customer service, and rewarding opportunities.

**Job Summary****:**


Manages a team responsible for purchasing and the processing of requisitions for specified categories, typically for low to mid\-level requirements leveraging non\-RFP market strategies. Manages performance measurements, analysis, and tracking of target achievements for the Transactional Procurement team tasked with addressing stakeholder demand across all Agencies. Delegates workload as appropriate to team members and serves as the ultimate escalation path for MTA stakeholders within Transactional Procurement. Responsible for group recruiting, staff development, and performance appraisal.


**Responsibilities:**

* Manages a team responsible for processing requisitions using non\-RFP market strategies for goods and services not owned by Category Management or Sourcing.
* Leverages approved buying channel strategies and directs team accordingly to ensure optimal value capture from defined processes.
* Helps to define goals for the team, provides input to plans to achieve strategic targets, monitors progress of respective team, and adjusts plan to ensure goals are achieved.
* Ensures the observance of compliance with standards, policies, and procedures, including contributing to the development of purchasing standards and procedures.
* Ensures purchasing competitiveness at an Agency level.
* Participates in supplier performance reviews to improve or maintain timely and issue\-free delivery of products and services.
* Manages critical business relationships with external suppliers and business stakeholders, including policy interpretation and guidance to stakeholders and contractors.
* Manages issue escalations for related Transactional Procurement activities.
* Collaborates with the Legal Department regarding legal and contractual issues and/or litigation by providing information, documentation, and depositions, as required.
* Prepares materials for Federal Triennial Audits, as required.
* Meets savings and value creation targets.
* Meets diversity spend targets for assigned scope.
* Achieves a high percentage of events planned versus executed, team operations excellence, and team competency improvement.
* Delegates assignments and monitors team progress, manages team to prioritize objectives and lead them to completion.
* Responsible for the recruiting, development, and performance appraisal of assigned staff.

 **Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:*** Supply chain management, bidding and sealed bidding processes, contract writing and administration.
* Knowledge of best practice procure\-to\-pay processes, related policies, procedures, and risks, with ability to apply understanding to daily work
* Collaboration skills with ability to build effective relationships, as well as influence peers, customers, business partners, and staff.
* Project management skills, ability to plan and track, remove barriers, manage change, resolve conflict, build consensus, and motivate team members across multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messages to the given audience and present information in a clear and concise manner.
* Strong prioritization and organization skills, with ability to multitask in a fast\-paced and challenging environment.
* Experience using ERP Purchasing applications and other procurement\-related software.
* Knowledge of government procurement requirements such as sealed bids, advertising requirements, and diversity spend targets.

 **Required Education and Experience:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in Supply Chain Management, Procurement and Contract Management, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in a Procurement function with a focus on commercial transaction procurement.

**Other Information**  

May need to work outside of normal work hours (i.e., evenings and weekends)


Travel may be required to other MTA locations or other external sites.


According to the New York State Public Officers Law \& the MTA Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the NYS Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the “Commission”).

**Equal Employment Opportunity**


MTA and its subsidiary and affiliated agencies are Equal Opportunity Employers, including those concerning veteran status and individuals with disabilities.


The MTA encourages qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, including military service members, to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Search Access Team, Google Search
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 8 years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, or system architecture, specifically driving infrastructure migrations, system deprecations, or API lifecycle rollouts.
* Experience delivering technical programs that enforce legal, regulatory, or data governance compliance for API platforms.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Demonstrated interest or experience in integrating generative AI frameworks, Large Language Models (LLMs), or autonomous workflows directly into program tracking, reporting, and operational task automation.
* Proven ability to act as the primary technical triage authority for critical, high\-friction enterprise partners (such as financial or sovereign clients) navigating strict constraints.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Search Access team defines, secures, and modernizes access to Google Search for the global ecosystem. Serving as the primary entry point for Google’s search technology, we own the platforms, APIs, and compliance architectures that expose our search index externally. Our portfolio manages billions of daily queries, protects critical syndication revenue streams, and implements rigorous regulatory guardrails while delivering Google’s next\-generation AI search capabilities to external developers, enterprises, and partners.


As a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Search Ecosystem, you will serve as the single point of accountability directing high\-stakes platform migrations and strategic syndication compliance initiatives. Your mandate is orchestrating the comprehensive global deprecation of legacy unmanaged full\-web search. Simultaneously, you will lead the end\-to\-end technical and commercial onboarding of partners onto the flagship Web Search Service (WSS).


In this role, you will safeguard strategic alliances, enforce strict legal and regulatory compliance, and align cross\-functional teams across engineering, product, and partnerships. To maximize operational velocity, you will pioneer the adoption of generative AI and autonomous workflows across all workstreams. You will brings extensive experience leading large\-scale API migrations, deep comfort with distributed system architectures, and the executive presence to influence senior cross\-functional leaders and external partners.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead cross\-functional execution to sunset legacy unmanaged full\-web search, enforcing traffic\-shaping to ensure a zero\-downtime migration.
* Govern end\-to\-end technical and commercial migrations of high\-value enterprise partners onto the unified Web Search Service (WSS) and modern commercial frameworks.
* Serve as primary triage authority for high\-friction enterprise partners while implementing auditable guardrails to satisfy legal obligations and strict syndication SLAs.
* Partner with search engineering, product, legal, cloud, and ads leadership to align modernization strategy, track risk burndowns, and deliver executive briefings.
* Integrate generative AI and autonomous workflows to automate migration tracking, eliminate operational toil, and boost program velocity.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** IT Infrastructure Project Manager  



**Location:** Hybrid New York City  



**Firm Overview:**

Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries (“Newmark”), is a world leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors and other owners, global corporations and other occupiers, and lenders. Built with purpose and driven by excellence, Newmark’s comprehensive platform is uniquely tailored to provide superior outcomes to clients. For the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of more than $3\.6 billion. As of June 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from over 195 offices with more than 10,000 professionals across four continents. Learn more at **nmrk.com** or follow **@newmark** .


Newmark is seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure Project Manager to lead complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives across Newmark's global environment. Reporting to the Global Head of IT Support \& Operations, this position will have primary responsibility for managing infrastructure projects associated with Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A), IT integrations, office relocations and facilities projects, technology migrations, audit and governance initiatives, and enterprise infrastructure programs.


The role requires a strong project manager who can coordinate multiple technical and business workstreams, manage dependencies and risks, work effectively with senior stakeholders and vendors, and drive projects from initial planning through implementation and operational handoff.  



**Responsibilities:**

**Mergers \& Acquisitions and IT Integrations**

* Manage IT workstreams associated with acquisitions, mergers, divestitures, and business integrations.
* Develop and manage comprehensive IT integration plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and cutover activities.
* Coordinate infrastructure discovery and technology assessments for acquired organizations.
* Partner with Infrastructure, Network, Endpoint, Security, Applications, Identity, Service Desk, and business teams to develop integration requirements and timelines.
* Coordinate migration and integration of users, devices, email, identity, data, applications, networks, telephony, collaboration platforms, and other technology services.
* Track Day 1 readiness, transition activities, migration waves, stabilization, and post\-integration activities.
Coordinate with acquired\-company IT teams, external vendors, and Newmark stakeholders throughout the integration lifecycle.  
* 

**Facilities, Office Relocations \& Real Estate Projects**

* Manage IT delivery for new offices, office relocations, expansions, consolidations, renovations, and closures.
* Partner closely with Facilities, Corporate Real Estate, business leadership, infrastructure teams, and external vendors.
* Develop technology requirements, budgets, schedules, equipment plans, and implementation timelines aligned with construction and move schedules.
* Coordinate circuits, structured cabling, network switches, Wi\-Fi, workstation technology, conference rooms, printers, telephony, AV, and other office technology requirements.
* Track equipment procurement, vendor delivery, installation, testing, and site readiness.
Coordinate technology cutovers and ensure offices are operational and ready for employees on scheduled move\-in dates.  
* 

**Technology Migrations**

* Lead enterprise infrastructure and technology migration projects.
* Develop migration strategies, schedules, user groups, communication plans, testing requirements, cutover plans, rollback plans, and post\-migration support.
* Coordinate Microsoft 365, Exchange, SharePoint, file/data, identity, endpoint, network, cloud, and collaboration\-platform migrations.
* Manage migration dependencies across internal engineering teams, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors.
* Track migration progress, exceptions, remediation activities, and overall completion.
Ensure appropriate validation and operational handoff following migrations.  
* 

**Infrastructure Project Management**

* Lead projects from initiation and requirements gathering through planning, execution, implementation, stabilization, and closure.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, decision logs, and project documentation.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and workstreams across different business units and geographic regions.
* Establish clear project ownership, deliverables, deadlines, and accountability across technical teams.
* Facilitate project kickoffs, working sessions, status meetings, steering meetings, and post\-implementation reviews.
* Identify risks and issues early and drive resolution or escalation to appropriate leadership.
Ensure completed projects transition successfully into operational support.  
* 

**Audit, Risk \& Governance**

* Manage and coordinate technology initiatives associated with internal and external audits, IT controls, risk remediation, compliance, and governance requirements.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, Risk, Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, Infrastructure, and other technology teams.
* Track audit findings, remediation plans, control gaps, owners, target dates, supporting evidence, and closure.
* Coordinate collection and validation of documentation and evidence required for audits and governance reviews.
* Maintain clear reporting of open findings, risks, dependencies, and remediation status.
* Ensure infrastructure projects follow Newmark's technology standards, security requirements, change management processes, and governance frameworks.
Support continuous improvement of project governance, documentation, reporting, and operational controls.  
* 

**Vendor, Procurement \& Financial Management**

* Coordinate third\-party technology vendors, managed service providers, telecommunications providers, consultants, and implementation partner

At Safe Fleet our name says it all. We make fleet vehicles – and everyone in and around them – safer. Our fleet safety platform brings together best\-in\-class products, ground\-breaking technology, and a 100\-year history of fleet know\-how and innovation to solve the world’s biggest fleet safety problems.

**DATA ANALYTICS AND RESEARCH TEAM**

**POSTED: 9/21/2026**


**ABOUT CJA**



The New York City Criminal Justice Agency (CJA) is a not\-for\-profit service and research organization that operates in partnership with the New York City Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice. CJA is the City's main pretrial services agency, combining operations, pilot projects, and research under one roof. CJA utilizes procedural justice practices to provide pretrial services to over 100,000 arrested annually in New York City. Information collected about these arrestees and subsequent case processing is maintained in the agency's internal and externally shared database systems, which are used to conduct descriptive and evaluation research on arrestee characteristics, case processing and court outcomes, and on issues and potential reforms to criminal justice policy in New York City. CJA's programs operate in the criminal courts and detention facilities 24 hours a day seven days a week within the 5 boroughs of NYC, employing over 300 employees, citywide.


**PROGRAM SUMMARY**



DART – We lead research and analytics that turn CJA's unparalleled justice system data into insights that drive policy and practice. Drawing on over 100,000 annual face\-to\-face interviews and comprehensive data feeds from police, courts, and corrections, we analyze complex trends, evaluate emerging policies, and apply causal techniques to assess the impact of policy and applied interventions. Through rigorous analysis, compelling visualizations, and impactful publications, we illuminate the workings of New York City's justice system and advance new lines of inquiry to shape a fairer, more effective system.

**Summary**
-----------


This vacancy is for a Management and Program Analyst in the Office of the Secretary within the Department of Commerce.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**


Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.
### **Military spouses**


Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.
### **Clarification from the agency**


All U.S. Citizens


  
**Duties**
----------


As a Management and Program Analyst, you will perform the following duties:


* Conduct analyses of administrative and programmatic functions, and organizational structures of moderate to considerable complexity, and develops recommendations to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of work operations.
* Develop and recommends modifications to methods, organizational structures, and management processes to enhance program performance and operational efficiency.
* Provide analytical support in the evaluation of administrative functions and services, ensuring alignment with program objectives and mission requirements.
* Serve as a liaison with internal and external stakeholders to assess program requirements, coordinate information flow, and support program integration and decision\-making.
* Evaluate administrative and operational processes related to meetings, reporting and program coordination, and recommends improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Analyze administrative documentation and program data related to personnel, budget, and operational activities to support management decision\-making.
* Identify needs and develops recommendations to modify administrative policies and processes for use in the management and direction of programs and develops data required for the organization to accomplish new requirements.
* Research current or new management practices for application to programs or operations.
* Develop management and/or program evaluation plans and procedures within established evaluation frameworks that accommodate changing OMB, Departmental, and/or program office performance management requirements and yield improvements in organization, staffing, work methods, and procedures.
* Support the supervisor in monitoring administrative control systems such as those designed to prevent waste, loss, unauthorized use, or misappropriation of assets.
* Review administrative audit and investigative reports to determine appropriate changes or corrective action required.
* Analyze findings and makes recommendations for how to implement corrective actions.

This position is also advertised under **OS\-OCIO\-26\-MP\-13067131**, which is open to Merit Promotion eligible applicants. You must apply to both announcements if you want to be considered for both.  

  

**This Job Opportunity Announcement may be used to fill other Management and Program Analyst GS\-0343\-12, FPL 13 (or equivalent pay band) positions within the Department of Commerce in the same geographical location or local commuting area with the same qualifications and specialized experience.**
  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**

**Company Description** **Big challenges need bold thinkers.**


If you’re someone who sees problems as opportunities, you’ll thrive here. **RESPEC is 100% employee\-owned**, which means we take ownership of every challenge. Here, your ideas drive real solutions. Since 1969, we’ve tackled complex challenges in energy transition, infrastructure resilience, digital transformation, and sustainability.

**At RESPEC, you’ll work alongside clients to take on critical problems**. Depending on your expertise, you might design infrastructure in remote locations, develop renewable energy solutions for global projects, or apply data\-driven technology to improve mining and water systems.


We bring deep technical knowledge, real\-world experience, and a commitment to work that matters. If you're looking for a place where your contributions have real impact, you’ll fit right in.

**We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters.**

 **Job Description**  

RESPEC is looking to hire an experienced **IT Asset Project Manager – Intermediate** to support Indian Affairs (IA) and Office of Information Technology (OIT) programs, projects, and operational initiatives.


The IT Asset Project Manager provides specialized expertise in **IT Asset Management (ITAM)** while managing assigned IT projects throughout the project lifecycle. This position serves as an intermediate\-level Project Manager and coordinates Government, business, technical, security, vendor, and contractor stakeholders to manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, assets, documentation, compliance, and delivery performance.


The position is responsible for supporting the lifecycle management of hardware, software, licenses, and related IT assets, including inventory management, asset traceability, product cataloging, ownership and assignment, location and status tracking, vendor coordination, service\-request fulfillment, product authorization, and associated financial and operational processes.


In addition to IT Asset Management expertise, the successful candidate must bring substantive experience in at least one complementary IT delivery discipline: **Change \& Configuration Management, Business Analysis, or Quality Management**.


Working with the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), Federal Task Lead, project teams, vendors, and other stakeholders, the IT Asset Project Manager manages resources, risks, dependencies, and customer relationships and supports successful delivery in accordance with task order requirements, federal standards, and Department of the Interior (DOI) and Indian Affairs (IA) policies and procedures.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**IT Asset Management**

* Manage and support the lifecycle of hardware, software, licenses, and related IT assets from acquisition and deployment through maintenance, reassignment, retirement, and disposition.
* Maintain full traceability of IT assets, including inventory status, product information, vendor information, asset location, assigned user, ownership, lifecycle status, and other required data.
* Support hardware, software, software license, and property\-management activities using approved automated and manual processes.
* Maintain accurate, complete, current, and auditable IT asset records within applicable systems, repositories, catalogs, and databases.
* Oversee IT service\-request fulfillment through the IA Service Center ticketing system and other approved processes.
* Coordinate the assessment, approval, and fulfillment of customer requests for software and hardware.
* Support IT asset contract execution, including customer chargebacks, invoicing, reconciliation, and related documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding products, licensing, support, maintenance, renewals, asset information, and other operational requirements.
* Coordinate updates to user groups in Microsoft Intune or other IA systems to support authorized software delivery.
* Maintain product and asset information within applicable Technical Reference Models, product catalogs, repositories, and asset\-management systems.
* Coordinate analysis and technical review of proposed hardware and software products.
* Support product\-authorization processes, including risk assessment, technical review, monitoring, approval tracking, documentation, and customer communications.
* Monitor hardware and software inventory and identify discrepancies, incomplete records, data\-quality issues, and lifecycle risks.
* Support software\-license tracking and help identify licensing, utilization, renewal, compliance, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with Change and Configuration Management teams to maintain alignment between IT asset records, Configuration Items (CIs), and applicable Configuration Management Database (CMDB) information.
* Develop and maintain IT Asset Management reports, dashboards, metrics, workflows, procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve asset\-management processes, inventory accuracy, data quality, operational controls, service\-request fulfillment, customer service, and lifecycle management.

**Project Management**

* Manage assigned IT projects throughout the project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, transition, and closeout.
* Apply Project Management Institute (PMI) principles, Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK) practices, Agile methodologies, Waterfall methodologies, and hybrid approaches appropriate to project requirements.
* Lead and facilitate Program Increment (PI) Planning activities and associated planning, coordination, and follow\-up.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, roadmaps, guides, templates, forms, governance artifacts, decision records, status reports, and other required project documentation.
* Coordinate information collection, review, approval, version control, and maintenance of project records.

**Senior Data Analyst (Data Integration \& Quality Lead)**
==========================================================


**Dynamic Business Intelligence Resources, LLC (D\-BIR)**  

**Position Type:** Full\-Time  

**Location:** Primarily Remote / Potential Travel  

**Security Clearance:** Active security clearance preferred  

**Position Status:** Contingent upon contract award and final workshare  

About D\-BIR  

Dynamic Business Intelligence Resources, LLC (D\-BIR) is a Veteran\-Owned Small Business specializing in mission\-driven digital and systems transformation for Federal Government customers. We help organizations integrate data, improve business processes, modernize information environments, and turn complex operational data into trusted information for decision\-making.  

D\-BIR is seeking an experienced **Senior Data Analyst (Data Integration \& Quality Lead)** to support an anticipated Department of War Education Activity (DoWEA) facilities program. This position will play a key role in integrating, validating, reconciling, documenting, and managing facility and real property information across multiple Government systems, datasets, field assessment activities, and technical deliverables.  

This is not solely a dashboard\-development position. We are looking for a senior analyst who is equally comfortable working with databases, data quality, business processes, system documentation, Government stakeholders, and technical teams.  

Position Overview  

The Senior Data Analyst will support the development and execution of an integrated data management and quality approach connecting facility assessments, real property information, facility utilization data, asset records, technical documentation, and Government systems of record.  

The successful candidate will help establish and maintain the data structures, validation controls, crosswalks, documentation, reconciliation processes, and quality\-management practices needed to ensure that information remains accurate, complete, traceable, consistent, secure, and usable throughout the program lifecycle.  

The position requires an individual who can work independently at a senior level while collaborating closely with program managers, facility professionals, engineers, inspectors, Government stakeholders, and other technical subject matter experts.  

Key Responsibilities  

The Senior Data Analyst will:  

* Lead or support data integration, data quality, reconciliation, and technical data\-management activities across multiple facility\-related datasets and Government systems.
* Develop and maintain data dictionaries, schema documentation, data models, field definitions, business rules, reference data, and source\-to\-target mappings.
* Establish and maintain master facility, building, asset, and real property crosswalks across disparate data sources and identifiers.
* Perform complex data profiling, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, and validation to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, incomplete, or conflicting records.
* Develop repeatable data\-quality rules and automated or semi\-automated validation processes.
* Track data discrepancies from identification through analysis, Government decision, system update, verification, and closure.
* Support synchronization of approved information across databases, reports, spreadsheets, drawings, SharePoint environments, and other authorized systems.
* Work with facility condition, utilization, real property, environmental, and other technical teams to ensure field\-generated information is properly associated with the correct facility, asset, component, space, or record.
* Support BUILDER SMS, Enterprise Sustainment Management System (E\-SMS), or related facility asset\-management data activities as authorized and qualified.
* Support Real Property Inventory reconciliation, including facility identifiers, RPUIDs, facility numbers, ownership, status, square footage, geolocation, and related attributes.
* Develop and maintain documentation describing datasets, schemas, analytical pipelines, collection methodologies, databases, interfaces, dependencies, transformations, and operating processes.
* Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), user guides, process documentation, workflow diagrams, architecture diagrams, and technical reference materials.
* Maintain data lineage, version history, change\-control records, decision logs, discrepancy registers, and other auditable technical records.
* Support database and data\-pipeline operations, controlled imports and exports, data transformations, and recurring data\-processing activities.
* Develop Power BI reports, dashboards, metrics, and other analytical products to communicate data quality, reconciliation status, operational performance, exceptions, and program risk.
* Use Microsoft Power Platform capabilities, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, and SharePoint, to support authorized workflow automation, tracking, reporting, and information\-management solutions.
* Develop queries and analytical processes using SQL and other appropriate data tools.
* Work with program leadership to define data\-quality metrics, KPIs, performance measures, quality gates, and reporting requirements.
* Support quality\-control reviews prior to release of datasets, documentation, system updates, and analytical deliverables.

jobs.title: Cyber Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Description:
**About Us:**


eSimplicity is a modern digital services company that partners with government agencies to improve the lives and protect the well\-being of all Americans, from veterans and service members to children, families, and seniors. Our engineers, designers, and strategists cut through complexity to create intuitive products and services that equip federal agencies with solutions to courageously transform today for a better tomorrow.


We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Cyber Business Analyst to support help desk and customer service operations for a large\-scale SaaS data analytics platform (Palantir Foundry). In this role, you will act as a key liaison between users, engineers, and data stakeholders, providing Tier 1 triage and Tier 2 troubleshooting platform issues, data pipelines, and analytic workflows. You will help ensure reliable platform operations by resolving user issues, supporting data integration efforts, and improving overall user experience.


Working closely with the Envision Program Office and Warp Core Program Executive Office, you will operate in a fast\-paced support environment, delivering timely issue resolution, communicating risks and blockers, and driving continuous improvements in platform usability and help desk processes. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, technically adept, and customer\-focused, with a strong ability to translate complex technical issues for both technical and non\-technical audiences.

**Location:** Remote Work with travel to Pentagon DC and Los Angeles AFB CA


This position is contingent upon contract award.

**Responsibilities:**

* Attend Project Meetings: Participate in calls to identify new data sources or additional data required to support ongoing platform work.
* Schedule Meetings: Coordinate meetings with data source owners and requestors to determine the best approach, establish connections, document processes, and integrate data.
* Provide Tier 1 triage and Tier 2 troubleshooting/support for data analytics workflows, platform functionality, user issues, and operational incidents within Palantir Foundry.
* Support users working with data pipelines, analytic workflows, data models, and operational datasets by identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving platform and data\-related issues.
* Work within both code\-based and low\-code/no\-code solutions across the platform to support analytic development, operational workflows, and user requirements.
* Support and troubleshoot data integration capabilities, including REST API connectivity, data ingestion/export processes, and system\-to\-system integrations.
* Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and platform administrators to resolve complex technical and data\-related issues.
* Document troubleshooting procedures, recurring issues, operational processes, and user support guidance to improve platform sustainment and support operations.
* Support continuous improvement efforts related to platform usability, operational efficiency, data reliability, and analytic workflow optimization.
* Leverage collaboration tools such as Slack, Teams, Outlook, Sharepoint to communicate, document, and share information across the team.
* Create documentation repositories and standard operating procedures for help desk actions. Create processes for automation of reoccurring issues to more efficiently use resources.
* Collaborate with ISSM Team: Provide the ISSM team with up\-to\-date and accurate information on each data source request to facilitate the Approval Official (AO) approval process.
* Prioritization for CCB Board: Offer prioritization for data connections to the CCB board, which directs the ISSM and engineering teams efforts to finalize connections.
* Support Engineering Team: Assist in restoring degraded connections through password resets, identifying points of contact (POCs), and scheduling troubleshooting sessions.
* User Forum Support: Respond to questions on the Teams "User Forum" or seek input from the engineering team for accurate responses.
* Facilitate Engineering Inquiries: Assist the engineering team with data\-related questions by coordinating discussions between engineers and data SMEs for each connected data source.
* General Account Management: Create and configure user accounts with appropriate access levels; provide user support, including addressing account\-related issues; manage user access to ensure compliance with security protocols, ect.
* Review migration plans of any data sources and update documentation. Ensure that Engineers members follow data connection processes. Define and operate the organization's data management tools.


Requirements:
**Required Qualifications:**

* Top Secret Security Clearance.
* Minimum of 4\-7 years of experience.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineer, Data Science).
* Experience working in a government headquarters staff, preferably in support of the Department of Defense or Air Force.
* Understanding data governance, data integration, and data quality management.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity protocols, particularly related to data protection and compliance (e.g., ATO, PIA, MOA, DSA).
* Awareness of government procedures and protocols, especially those relevant to data sharing and collaboration.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively coordinate with data source owners, requestors, and engineering teams.
* Ability to work independently and as a part of a team.
* Ability to manage multiple data connection projects, prioritize tasks, and ensure timely completion.
* Knowledge of data analytics principles, data modeling concepts, and enterprise data environments.
* Knowledge of REST API technologies, Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, and data integration methodologies
* Knowledge of cloud\-based or enterprise\-scale analytics platforms and modern data architectures.
* Skill in Python, SQL, PySpark, and TypeScript/Jav

jobs.description:
We are:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
* This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI\-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

  

The Work:

* Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy \& Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
* Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
* Leverage AI\-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
* Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
* Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast\-moving transformation engagement

  

You are:


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.


  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

  

* Program or project management at a top\-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi\-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
* A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Strong executive\-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision\-ready materials.
* Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.
