jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Supply Chain, Google Beam
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with supply chain planning.
* Experience with hardware product development.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google Beam is a true\-to\-life new communication technology from Google that allows people to feel like they’re having real face\-to\-face conversations, no matter the distance. Powered by realistic state\-of\-the\-art 3D imaging and spatial audio and integrated with today’s leading remote video platforms, Google Beam enables you to be immersed in the moment, together. As a part of the Google Beam team, you'll work with incredible teammates across all major functions in a fast\-paced product\-oriented environment. Your contributions will have an impact on the future of communications with Google products. You will apply technology to solve that really important problem that we often want to be together and we can’t.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

--------------------

* Lead a governance structure that drives effective executive decision\-making. Ensure governance structure effectively exposes and mitigates dependencies.
* Seek out and identify change management opportunities that increase program velocity and which affect multiple teams.
* Define/manage a program portfolio solving problems that target high business impact for the organization and product area.

**WHO WE ARE**  

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**  

The vision for the Assistant Project Manager – Estimating to Traveling role will be to train with the Energy division’s Estimating team, with intent to convert to an onsite traveling Assistant Project Manager position.


During the Assistant Project Manager’s training period with the Energy division’s Estimating team, they will: work closely with the Preconstruction team, Project Managers, Purchasing, Engineering, and report to the Chief Estimator \- Energy. The Estimator will be responsible for developing and completing utility scale solar PV and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) estimates, including self\-perform and subcontracted scopes of work. Estimating includes RFP \& drawing package review, developing proposal level designs, quantity take\-off, material RFQ prep \& evaluation, and subcontractor RFQ prep \& evaluation.

* Identifies cost impacts associated with RFIs, submittals, and design changes and provides timely notification.
* Prices change orders consistently and in a timely manner for project manager review and approval.
* Manages close out documents.
* Coordinate commissioning activities w/ 3rd party. Tracks and follows up on open items.
* Maintain strong working partnerships with vendors and subcontractors. Coordinates accurate material releases on time and consistent with project documents. Track material releases, changes and coordinate delivery with construction schedule.

**ABOUT YOU**  

You bring innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project with prior experience supervising and/or providing guidance to others. You possess technical knowledge and communication skills, which are vital to an Assistant Project Manager’s success. You have experience providing in\-house support to Project Managers such as coordinating, tracking quantities complete for billing, and managing project activities and documentation. You bring a willingness to learn and are on the lookout for ways to improve existing processes.

* Serve as the go\-to person to help resolve any issues or potential problem areas.
* Actively thinks about new ways to improve or change processes. Brings innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project.
* Prior experience working on semi\-remote jobsites, supervising others. Renewables/Large Electrical/Data Center build experience highly desired.
* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.
* Experience with Accubid estimating software preferred.
* Scheduling ability with Microsoft Projects and/or Primavera P6 experience preferred.
* Knowledge of Electrical Code and Civil Construction.

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**  

As an Assistant Project Manager (APM) at Cupertino Electric, you will be empowered to learn the skills and competencies required to become a successful Project Manager. APMs have the opportunity to execute Project Manager level activities within the safety of the larger Project Team. This is when all of the deep, technical, and process\-guided learning comes into play. Partnered with a Project Manager, through practice and feedback, you will learn the processes, and witness the critical thinking required for strategic project approach, which will in turn set you up for a successful future on your career path. You will be interacting extensively with the CEI Production Team, customers, and vendor and subcontractor partners, giving you opportunities to cultivate relationships and build your professional network.

jobs.title: Life Sciences - Reinvention Program Manager
jobs.description:
We are:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
* This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI\-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

  

The Work:

* Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy \& Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
* Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
* Leverage AI\-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
* Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
* Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast\-moving transformation engagement

  

You are:


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.


  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

  

* Program or project management at a top\-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi\-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
* A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Strong executive\-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision\-ready materials.
* Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

  

Preferred skills/experience:

  

* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMP, Agile/Scrum (CSM, SAFe), or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience managing AI\-enabled transformation programs or enterprise change initiatives in Life Sciences.
* Familiarity with AI agent orchestration tools for program reporting, status automation, or backlog management.
* Track record at a top\-tier consulting firm managing large\-scale transformation program delivery across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience in software engineering, technical solution development or product development.
Experience designing, building, and deploying AI models and intelligent agents.  
* 

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience driving internal tool adoption and executing structured change management strategies across large\-scale engineering teams.
* Experience partnering with engineering teams to rapidly iterate, prototype, deliver and debug software solutions.
* Domain expertise in agentic development (e.g., enterprise RAG systems, Large Language Model (LLM) guardrails, and context management frameworks).

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


In this role, you will drive an organizational transformation of program management by modernizing workflows, embedding AI at the core of our operations, and engineering AI first platforms.


Team’s strategic priorities include driving standardization of AI2 Program Data Corpus by building data\-capsules for all AI2 programs. Building connectivity between other AI investments including TeamLLM (Team data layer) and PVP (Resources data layer). Providing a rich operational and presentation layer for users on 007, Jetski, LLM extension etc. surfaces. Building autonomous agents, handling end to end program management for common use cases. Building a program execution data Oracle for al2, so that execution knowledge is accrued with every project AI2 ships, and becomes discoverable on will. Transforming Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and tools in meeting demands of the business execution in the agentic era.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $163000 \- $236000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

--------------------

* Lead use\-case analysis and author Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) to translate user needs into technical specifications. Design agentic workflows and tool integrations, collaborating with Engineering to deliver high\-quality interfaces across surfaces that meet stringent performance standards.
* Establish deterministic evaluation metrics to benchmark and assess tool quality, analyze results, and resolve performance issues. Partner directly with end users to debug quality concerns.
* Coordinate product testing and phased launches for new AI capabilities. Oversee platform access controls and perform adversarial testing to evaluate agent failure modes, such as API payload errors and execution timeouts.
* Develop change management playbooks and direct targeted onboarding initiatives to drive adoption.
* Identify, communicate, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders within one or more teams to drive impact and work toward mutual goals. Build, maintain and enhance business, operational, and management dashboards.

jobs.title: Data Center Project Manager, US-West CPI, Critical Projects Implementation
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operation data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.  

  

We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.  

  

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!  

  

A day in the life  

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.
  

  

About the team  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

\#DCCD\_AMER


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of construction or project management experience
* 5\+ years experience managing projects in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure in an operational space. Comparable critical infrastructure experience is defined as a facility that includes a 24/7 emergency backup system, manufacturing facility (semiconductor, auto, medical equipment or Clean rooms), Mass Transportation (freight or passenger rail), Oil and Gas, Utility, Hospitals or similar industry
* 5\+ years in on\-site construction trades (mechanical, electrical, general) Vendor Management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* 5\+ years experience managing projects in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure in an operational space. Comparable critical infrastructure experience is defined as a facility that includes a 24/7 emergency backup system, manufacturing facility (semiconductor, auto, medical equipment or Clean rooms), Mass Transportation (freight or passenger rail), Oil and Gas, Utility, Hospitals or similar industry
* 5\+ years

jobs.title: Protective Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you've been searching for!  

  

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open\-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.  

  

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:  

  

Integrity – Collaboration \- Relationships – Excellence – Creativity \- Results



Join Us,



Concentric \- "Your World Secured"


We are currently looking to hire a **Protective Intelligence Analyst** to join our team embedded with our client! This is a remote position.



This is a full time remote position, working Monday \- Friday during business hours, with flexibility in scheduling to ensure that after hour events and weekends are covered based on operational need.


**JOB DESCRIPTION**



The Protective Intelligence Analyst supports the intelligence function by identifying, assessing, and monitoring threats and risks to the Principal's family members, residences, travel, assets, and reputation. Reporting to the Intelligence Manager, this role is responsible for producing timely, actionable intelligence that supports protective decision\-making, travel security, residential security, and risk\-informed planning.



The analyst applies structured analytic tradecraft, open\-source intelligence (OSINT), digital risk monitoring, and threat assessment methodologies to detect indicators of concern, assess potential escalation, and inform protective posture. This role works closely with the Intelligence Manager, Director of Intelligence, protective operations personnel, and other trusted stakeholders to ensure intelligence is translated into practical security recommendations.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


### **Protective Intelligence Monitoring \& Threat Assessment**


* Monitor, identify, and assess threats related to personal safety, fixation, stalking, targeted violence, protest activity, extremism, kidnapping, harassment, and criminal activity.
* Conduct ongoing threat assessments related to the Principal, family members, residences, travel, and other areas of risk exposure.
* Identify behavioral, situational, and digital indicators that may suggest escalation toward harmful or disruptive activity.
* Support case management and threat monitoring efforts through timely collection, documentation, and analytic updates.

### **Intelligence Collection \& Analysis**


* Collect, evaluate, and synthesize information from open sources, internal reporting, trusted vendors, and other approved channels.
* Apply structured analytic techniques and sound source evaluation practices to produce clear, defensible assessments.
* Develop intelligence products including threat assessments, executive briefs, alerts, profiles, and monitoring summaries.
* Distinguish between credible threats, nuisance activity, and non\-threatening reporting through disciplined analytic judgment.

### **Travel \& Event Support**


* Support production of domestic and international travel risk assessments covering crime, civil unrest, terrorism, health concerns, infrastructure issues, and region\-specific threats.
* Monitor emerging developments that may affect travel, protective operations, or event security.
* Provide real\-time intelligence support during travel, special events, or elevated threat periods as directed by the Intelligence Manager.
* Assist in preparing advanced intelligence packages to support secure movement and informed decision\-making.

### **Residential \& Asset Risk Support**


* Support intelligence\-led assessments related to residences, estates, offices, aircraft, vessels, and other high\-value assets.
* Identify indicators of protest planning, surveillance, activist targeting, insider concerns, criminal interest, or other threats affecting physical locations.
* Provide analytic support to inform security posture decisions made by the Chief Security Officer and protective leadership.

jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you've been searching for!  

  

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open\-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.  

  

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:  

  

Integrity – Collaboration \- Relationships – Excellence – Creativity \- Results



Join Us,



Concentric \- "Your World Secured"


We are currently looking to hire an **Intelligence Manager** to join our team with our client! This is a remote position.



This is a full time remote position, working Monday \- Friday during business hours, with flexibility in scheduling to ensure that after hour events and weekends are covered based on operational need.


**JOB DESCRIPTION**



The Intelligence Manager is responsible for day‑to‑day leadership of intelligence production and operations, ensuring timely, high‑quality analytic outputs that support executive protection, business continuity, and strategic decision‑making. Manages delivery of forward‑looking assessments of safety, security, and reputational risks to the Principal, family members, residences, travel, assets, and operational footprint. The role translates the Director of Intelligence's strategic priorities into executable workflows, manages analysts and vendors, and serves as the primary integrator across security, GSOC, and business stakeholders.



This position emphasizes operational leadership, analytic rigor, and cross‑functional execution.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


#### **Intelligence Management \& Production**


* Lead daily and weekly intelligence production aligned to priorities set by the Director of Intelligence.
* Oversee development of threat assessments, travel risk assessments, strategic briefs, and executive‑level intelligence products.
* Ensure analytic standards, sourcing discipline, and confidence judgments are consistently applied.
* Maintain escalation thresholds and ensure timely notification of elevated risks to the Director.

#### **Team Leadership \& Workflow Execution**


* Manage intelligence analysts and contractors, including tasking, quality control, mentoring, and performance feedback.
* Translate strategic direction into collection plans, analytic lines of effort, and production schedules.
* Coordinate surge support during incidents, crises, or high‑risk travel/events.

#### **Stakeholder \& Cross‑Functional Integration**


* Brief internal stakeholders as delegated by the Director; support executive briefings with analysis and talking points.

#### **Threat Monitoring \& Incident Support**


* Oversee real‑time monitoring of geopolitical, protest, insider threat, reputational, and physical security risks.
* Support incident response with rapid assessments, actor profiling, and intent/capability analysis.

#### **Governance, Reporting \& Metrics**

jobs.description:
**CSQ427R137**


**Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE \- Digital Native Business**
=============================================================


**About the Team**
------------------


The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C\-suite\-sponsored, high\-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering *outcomes*, not just a platform.


You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production\-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."


**Role Description**
--------------------


As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi\-million\-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.


You will build C\-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.


This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands\-on delivery mindset.


**The impact you will have**
----------------------------


* **C\-Suite Scoping \& Value Definition:** Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M\+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands\-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* **Technical Solution Leadership** **\& Delivery:** Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C\-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure\-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* **Solution Launch \& Landing:** Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* **Strategic Handoff \& Growth:** Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high\-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

**What we look for**
--------------------


* **Executive Presence \& Communication:** You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* **Product Judgment \& Delivery:** You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* **Technical Fluency \& Architecture Judgment:** You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade\-offs, and pressure\-test technical decisions.
* **Hands\-on Technical Ability:** You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* **Relevant Experience:** Typically 7\+ years of experience delivering complex, customer\-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high\-growth technology company, forward\-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25\-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**Pay Range Transparency**


Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above.

$219,765—$302,220 USD

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Software
jobs.description:
### **About Mind:**


Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real\-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands\-on with the physical world every day \- and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

  

### **About the team and the role:**


Program Management at Mind is an operational catalyst. We own outcomes, drive the trade\-offs that keep engineering moving, and set the metabolic rate of the teams we partner with — clearing roadblocks, closing stalled decisions, carrying risk upward, and protecting the focus engineers need to build. As a Software Program Manager you will own the integrated program plan across all of software and build the practice itself: how teams define their own milestones and commit to org\-level ones, how we know week over week whether we are on or off track, and how problems surface early enough that we can still do something about them. You will partner directly with hardware program management so that software and hardware roll up into one program picture rather than two competing ones.

**Responsibilities:**

* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Own the software program plan end to end — from roadmap planning through implementation, integration, validation, and release to the fleet — and own the functional outcome, not just the schedule.
* **Program Practice Design:** Establish how software program management works at Mind: the planning rhythm that connects team\-level work to org\-level milestones, what qualifies as a milestone, what "done" means at each one, and the artifacts that support both the individual engineer and leadership in prioritization and decision making.
* **Milestone Planning:** Build software plans that align with org\-level milestones, including clear definitions of what “done” means at each step.
* **Metric Tracking:** Monitor and report on key program metrics, and communicate status, blockers, and risks to leadership.
* **Progress Tracking \& Status Integrity:** Build the tracking layer that answers whether we are on or off track, drawn from the systems teams already work in.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and escalate technical, dependency, and resourcing risks early, and and drive them to resolution.
* **Technical / Business Judgment:** Engage directly in architecture and design discussions at a depth sufficient to stress\-test engineering estimates and pressure\-test readiness. Drive decisions at that level with understanding of the impacts to our business goals.

### **Requirements:**

* **Educational Background:** Bachelor's degree in engineering (software / computer science preferred), or equivalent experience.
* **Industry Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in technical program management for software products, ideally in robotics, autonomous systems, or another domain where software ships against hardware and real\-world deployment constraints.
* **Proven Track Record:** Demonstrated success taking software from early development through release and sustained operation.
* **Technical Depth:** Strong software fundamentals with the ability to engage meaningfully in architecture, planning, and systems integration discussions.
* **System Complexity:** Experience managing programs spanning multiple interdependent software domains along with their dependencies on hardware revisions and the availability of test hardware.
* **Execution \& Ownership:** High sense of urgency, comfortable with ambiguity, and driven by an "engineering curiosity" to understand how the entire system works.

jobs.description:
**Compensation Range:**


$103,500\.00 \- $117,000\.00  


Plus Incentive Bonus based on Performance **Location:**


1301 S Lamar Blvd , Austin, Texas, 78704  


Alamo Drafthouse is looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to serve as the company's lead data expert, building the reporting and data infrastructure that lets Operations, Marketing, Development, and Finance trust the numbers they're making decisions on.  

  

This role reports directly to the VP of Finance and partners closely with Analytics Engineering within the IT team. The position works within a dbt\-centric analytics stack (Snowflake, dbt, Omni) where every change to shared data models ships through Git and a pull request review, following software engineering best practices. Day\-to\-day work sits closer to SQL \+ dbt \+ Git than to drag\-and\-drop dashboard building. You'll be equally responsible for hands\-on technical work and for building consensus across departments on what a metric means and which system is the source of truth for it.**WHAT WE OFFER**

* A fun workplace where you can be yourself and do awesome work!
* Free movies \& food
* Paid time off
* Competitive pay
* Flexible scheduling
* Medical, dental, vision, FSA, HSA, and voluntary benefits are available for **all full\-time and part\-time teammates**

**OUR MISSION:**

  

To Ensure EVERY Guest and Teammate Has An AWESOME Experience And Is EXCITED To Come Back

 **LOCATION:** *This is a* ***HYBRID*** *position; we are actively prioritizing candidates based in or near* ***Austin, TX (preferred) OR Los Angeles, CA.***

 **CORE ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain BI reports, dashboards, and datasets covering multi\-unit performance across our theaters — box office, food \& beverage, marketing performance, labor, inventory, and guest experience metrics.
* Translate evolving, cross\-functional business requirements from Operations, Marketing, Development, and Finance into clear, well\-scoped data visualizations.
* Build and optimize data models within our dbt transformation layer, and drive continuous improvement in reporting processes.
* Establish and maintain a shared metrics glossary and consistent data definitions across departments.
* Act as the escalation point for complex BI, data modeling, and reconciliation issues.
* Foster data democratization across the organization, including training and documentation so business users adopt self\-service tools confidently.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

***Must Haves***

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence.
* *Nice to Haves, but not a must*
* Direct hands\-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse platform such as BigQuery or Redshift).
* Direct hands\-on experience with Omni specifically.
* Python or another object\-oriented programming language.
* Experience supporting a multi\-unit, brick\-and\-mortar business model (i.e. cinema, restaurants, hotels, retail, grocery, or similar).
* Strong, daily\-use SQL skills, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries against large, multi\-source datasets.
* Hands\-on experience with dbt (or a comparable SQL\-based transformation framework), including comfort working within a large, shared model codebase.
* Working proficiency with Git/GitHub and a pull\-request\-based code review workflow.
* Experience building semantic models and dashboards in a modern BI platform (e.g., Omni, Looker/LookML, or similar).
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

 ***Nice to Haves, but not a must***

* Direct hands\-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse platform such as BigQuery or Redshift).
* Direct hands\-on experience with Omni specifically.
* Python or another object\-oriented programming language.

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Lifting and moving up to 30lbs
* Sitting for long periods of time

**OUR CORE VALUES:**

 **DO THE RIGHT THING**  

We strive to be a force of good in our company, in our industry and in the world. We stand up for our beliefs even when it is hard. We start from a place of kindness.  

  

**FOSTER COMMUNITY**  

We value what is unique about each other and celebrate our differences. We treat each other with respect, support each other’s passions, and help each other grow. We welcome healthy debate but don’t tolerate intolerance. We take this commitment outside our 4 walls, creating neighborhood theaters that are deeply tied to the local community.  

  

**BOLDLY GO**  

Like the crew of the Starship Enterprise™, we seek out new experiences and pursue innovation in all of our work. We take risks and chart new territory. We learn from our mistakes and continuously improve.  

  

**GIVE A SH!T**  

We are passionate about creating awesome experiences. We obsess over every detail and take pride in our work because we know it makes all the difference to our guests and our teammates. Our pursuit of excellence drives us to do our best.

**Company**: Alamo Drafthouse Cinema

new_jobs.title: Project Manager (UK)
new_jobs.description:
### **About the company**


**What’s Promptly in a nutshell**


Promptly is building the first patient\-centered global evidence network, offering real world data sharing and monetization capabilities. Together with a selected network of Partners, we generate new knowledge from harmonized datasets, augmented with the collection of longitudinal patient\-reported data and patient\-generated digital biomarkers within a secure and privacy\-preserving environment.


We answer the question – is this patient treatment the best it could possibly be?

  

  

**What’s our purpose**


We exist to empower every patient and every health organization on the planet with evidence on the outcomes of care!


Why do we get up in the morning? Well, most healthcare professionals have chosen to work in healthcare driven by their desire to make a difference in patients’ lives. And so have we! We have chosen to follow this calling by addressing the biggest problem in healthcare: the lack of real\-world evidence on the outcomes of care.


For us, society denying patients better care due to lack of access to data is unethical, in a world where technology improved so many aspects of our world. Making the right evidence available to healthcare organizations to help prevent one lost life, one care complication, one failed treatment is the moral obligation that big tech companies have – it’s our Hippocratic Oath.


At Promptly, everything we do is driven by our core purpose: to promote better healthcare at lower costs for patients every day, by making health outcomes available.


### **About the role**


As a Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in leading and coordinating a dedicated project that brings together patients, healthcare professionals, and technology teams. You will be responsible for the successful planning, execution, and delivery of initiatives across a federated health data programme. Acting as the bridge between business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable impact.


This role requires strong project management expertise combined with sharp stakeholder management skills and a structured, delivery\-oriented mindset. You do not need a technical background, but you must be comfortable navigating complex, multi\-stakeholder environments in the health technology sector.


**What you’ll be expected to do (Key responsibilities)**

* Define and manage project scope, objectives, timelines, and success metrics.
* Create and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, and resource allocations.
* Develop and track deliverables and milestones across workstreams involving patients, clinicians, and business stakeholders.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to agreed quality standards.
* Monitor budgets and financial performance, flagging deviations proactively.
  

  

*Stakeholder management \& communication*


* Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams, external partners, and user groups.
* Manage relationships with sponsors, executives, external collaborators, and patient and professional user groups.
* Translate complex requirements into clear, actionable plans and communications.
* Provide regular updates, presentations, and executive\-level reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Ensure continuous alignment between business objectives and delivery realities.
  

  

*Team leadership \& collaboration*


* Coordinate cross\-functional teams, ensuring accountability and collaboration across clinical, product, and business groups.
* Establish working methodologies, governance structures, and escalation paths.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports co\-creation and continuous improvement.
  

  

*Risk \& issue management*


* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks proactively.
* Maintain issue logs, track dependencies, and implement corrective actions.
* Escalate blockers and decisions with appropriate context and recommendations.
  

  

*Process \& tools*


* Utilise project management tools such as Jira to maintain visibility and control.
* Drive continuous improvement in project delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches).
* Contribute to customer success initiatives, supporting onboarding, adoption, and sustained value creation.
  

  

**What we’re looking for (qualifications \& skills)**


**Education \& certification**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Healthcare, or a related field.
* Professional certification in Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA) or Agile methodologies is a strong advantage, though not required.
  

  

**Experience**


* Minimum 5 years of proven experience in project management roles.
* Experience delivering projects in healthcare, digital health, or data\-driven environments is strongly preferred.
* Track record of managing cross\-functional or multi\-stakeholder teams across clinical, business, and technical groups.
* Demonstrated ability to manage executive\-level communication and reporting.
  

  

**Core skills**


* Exceptional communication, stakeholder engagement, and negotiation skills.
* Strong organisational and planning capabilities, with excellent attention to detail.
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset with a delivery\-oriented approach.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environments.
* Comfortable engaging with technical teams and translating outputs into business language, without needing to be technical yourself.
  

  

**Position**

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a driven Project Manager/Delivery Lead to work on the Contact Center Solutions Technology team. This team enables the rest of our associates in Contact Center Operations carry out its mission in serving our patients. A Project Manager/Delivery Lead, is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivery of defined deliverables as part of a larger program and almost always requires engagement from multiple teams. Key responsibilities include communicating the work objectives, coordinating delivery, managing risks, ensuring compliance to standards, and providing end\-to\-end visibility into the health of the deliverables. This role ensures execution and delivery meets or exceeds the client’s expectations in terms of the functionality, quality, timeline, and cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

* You will form teams, kick off projects and coordinate and facilitate routines to support delivery – e.g. status reviews, stakeholder meetings, change controls etc.
* You will shape the final product working with our Business Owners and teams. You will build resilient, supportable technology systems. And as part of that you will make plans and coordinate delivery and dependencies with across multiple teams.
* You will recognize, anticipate, and facilitate dependency management, risk management. You will remove impediments or know who to call and help remove.
* You will actively promote communication and collaboration across organizations to support the deliverable completion and timeline. You will think local (your team) and think global (AEI) and you will manage those two sometimes competing interests.
* You will lead delivery of technical sections of requirements as well as design, traceability matrix, deployment tasks and contingency/rollback plans.
* Software changes are done well but should also be documented well. You understand what "Change Management" means you ensure deliverables comply with Enterprise Change Management standards.
* You will provide status updates for the deliverables to stakeholders and leadership pertaining to delivery, risks/issues, and schedule.
* You will ensure that execution is aligned with deliverable requirements by working with the Business.
* You will support resource planning, manage the resource pipeline, recognize skill deficits, resource bottlenecks and help alleviate them.
* You will be the resource Management, Scrum Master for the Contact Center Solutions Dev team.

**Required Skills**

Bachelor’s Degree with 6 years’ experience in Business Information Services, or Computer Sciences preferred.

* Proven experience in Project Management, Planning, Estimation and Execution.
* Good understanding of Change Management and modern tools used for that purpose \- ServiceNow, JIRA etc.
* Ability to communicate complexity to an audience by tailoring the message.
* You will have an “ownership” mindset and are used to taking collective responsibility for every decision, owning, and managing errors and finding the right way.
* Demonstrate mature judgement in dealing with ambiguity and complexity and can demonstrate balancing enterprise needs over individual program’s
* Ability to handle multiple, competing priorities. There will always be things competing for your mindshare.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to solicit input from others.
* You will be part of a team that lives and breathes Agile and believes in The Manifesto. You understand Agile development and get it like driving on the road. Agile frameworks work alongside cultural values, and you have the cultural background.
* Ability to manage and prioritize the work of others, directly and indirectly working for you.
* Ability to talk to executives and develop presentation material. You understand the BLOT principle \- Bottom Line On Top.
* Persistence, poise, and perseverance to get things accomplished.
* Proven experience in project managing contact center automation and conversational AI initiatives, overseeing cross\-functional teams, enterprise integrations, solution performance monitoring, and continuous optimization to improve customer experience and achieve business outcomes.
* Understands project forecasting and managing project budgets, and PO’s across multiple service providing teams.
* Ability to be hands\-on. Not necessarily write code but you are close enough to technology to be able to guide, discern between competing technical solutions and make choices.
* Very good Excel skills – pivots, charting etc. is often helpful.
* At least 3\-5 years Contact Center experience.
* PMP certification.

* Health insurance

new_jobs.description:
**About Blue Water Thinking**



Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer\-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.



Founded by a decorated twenty\-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.



Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one\-team" approach and brings to bear best\-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.



Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.



Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long\-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

**Job Description:**



Blue Water Thinking is seeking an experienced and dedicated Senior Program Analyst to serve as Schedule Architect and P6 Migration Lead, supporting the Integrated Healthcare Transformation (IHT) initiative at the Department of Veterans Affairs HEFP SEP program. The role carries three linked mandates: architect the target Primavera P6 enterprise environment that a 1,100\+ project portfolio can sustain; map legacy data into logic\-driven schedules without loss of existing data or functionality; and support federal program managers and field staff through the change, with adoption as a key deliverable. All work is advisory; final decision\-making authority rests with the Government, and the incumbent does not draft procurement documents or perform inherently governmental functions.


**Responsibilities:**


***Migration Architecture and Data Mapping***  

* Assess the legacy Microsoft Project Web Access environment and produce a defensible mapping of every legacy data element to its P6 destination, including activity codes, user\-defined fields, WBS levels, calendars, or planned retirement, with rationale documented and Government\-approved.
* Design the enterprise architecture, including EPS hierarchy, WBS standards, activity coding dictionary, calendar library, and UDF strategy sized for portfolio\-scale reporting.
* Develop standardized fragnets and schedule templates by project archetype, including telecommunications room cutovers, data center relocations, elevator modernization, AHU/chiller replacement, and roof replacement.
* Convert milestone\-dominant legacy records into activities with durations and logic while preserving genuine milestones and maintaining legacy reporting during parallel operations until the Government accepts the new reporting.
* Establish and routinely report schedule health criteria, including open ends, negative lag, constraint use, out\-of\-sequence progress, excessive float, and missing predecessors or successors.

***Master Schedule Development, Integration, and Variance Analysis***  

* Build and manage master schedules with full traceability of program and project milestones defined by SEP federal program managers.
* Maintain schedule baselines, control baseline changes, and preserve audit trails of schedule revisions.
* Manage schedule data across design and construction projects spanning EHRM, recapitalization, and targeted infrastructure portfolios.
* Align the EHRM NRM Capital Integrated Schedule with the EHRMIO Integrated Master Schedule and coordinate with Oracle Health and VA stakeholders, including EHRMIO, OIT, OCFM, OAEM, and PCAC.
* Coordinate with VISN and VAMC engineering staff, site engineers, design and A/E firms, and general contractors to gather schedule events and establish dependencies.
* Analyze schedule data for critical path impact, downstream program effects, and schedule variance across deployment sites.
* Identify, quantify, and escalate schedule risks and support maintenance of the SEP risk register using recognized program risk management techniques.

***Coaching, Reporting, and Adoption***  

* Coach and mentor federal program managers, SEP lead engineers, and field staff on schedule interpretation, including critical path, float, milestone movement, and overall program impacts.
* Develop training aids, job aids, bulletins, quick\-reference guides, and SOPs, and provide recurring instruction through office hours, working sessions, recorded walkthroughs, and cohort training.
* Build and maintain Power BI and SharePoint reporting views that present P6 data in accessible terms and monitor adoption to identify areas requiring additional support or design improvements.
* Produce the weekly Capital Integrated Schedule and Risk/Event Report, support Capital Schedule and Variance Reports, and develop executive reporting showing milestone status and variance in clear, non\-technical language.

**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Must have previous federal government experience or experience working for a federal contractor.
* 8\+ years of professional scheduling experience supporting design and construction or capital infrastructure programs, including at least 3 years at a senior or lead level within a multi\-project portfolio.
* Demonstrated experience converting a milestone\-based, spreadsheet\-based, or tracking\-register system into a logic\-driven CPM schedule, including responsibility for data mapping and conversion decisions.
* Expert\-level experience with Oracle Primavera P6 Professional and EPPM

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Virtual PIR – Remote
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Lead the delivery of the Virtual Program for Initial Resettlement (VPIR) to achieve client enrollment and employment outcomes while ensuring high\-quality, compliant service delivery in a fully virtual environment. Supervise staff, manage workloads, and provide ongoing coaching and training to support program success. Oversee program reporting, documentation, performance monitoring, and contract compliance while coordinating with partners and stakeholders to strengthen outcomes. Work closely with CWS Pre\-Arrival and Post\-Arrival teams to ensure alignment and compliance with PIR requirements and regularly collaborate with other Initial Resettlement Providers (IRPs) implementing VPIR services. ***This role is subject to the continued availability of funding.***
About CWS:

Imagine waking up every morning with the chance to change someone's life. Imagine knowing your efforts will benefit both your career and our neighbors around the world. At CWS, our team knows they are making a difference every day. Whether you're in our U.S.\-based offices supporting refugees, asylees or unaccompanied children ... implementing hygiene initiatives in Cambodia or rebuilding projects in Central America ... or even connecting remotely from your home on fundraising campaigns, grant reports, or critical communications \- you have the opportunity to work towards a world where everyone has food, a voice and a safe place to call home.
Responsibilities:

Core Duties  

Program Management* Responsible for meeting program goals, client enrollments, and job placements as established by the contract guidelines.
* Monitor general client well\-being and conduct random sample reviews of client case notes and case files to ensure quality and timeliness of service provision and fulfillment of documentation requirements.
* Ensure coordination among the different components of programming and community partners.
* Stay up to date on program changes, best practices and funder requirements.
* Ensure professionalism and quality employment service provision. Provide ongoing training to staff on program developments and service requirements.

  

People Management
* Recruit, hire, train, supervise, and evaluate staff in accordance with CWS personnel policies and guidance from CWS Human Resources.
* Promote teamwork, coordinate the workload of staff, delegate responsibilities, and hold staff accountable.
* Provide ongoing training to staff on program developments and service requirements.
* Develop trainings which include a detailed explanation of program services, including but not limited to; acculturation, adult education, employment, mentoring/youth services and immigration legal services.
* Promote teamwork, coordinate the workload of staff, delegate responsibilities, and hold staff accountable.

  

Grants, Reporting, and Compliance
* Coordinate and manage all aspects of the program including contract compliance, workflow coordination, quality control and the enhancements of services.
* Monitor compliance of programs with program requirement and CWS guidelines and procedures
* Complete required funder reports, coordinating with team members to ensure proper tracking and reporting of activities.
* Prepare for and participate in on\-site monitoring visits with leadership teams.

  

Partnerships and Development
* Develop partnerships with local providers, volunteers, mentors and community organizations that support program goals and client needs
* Present programs to employers, local school districts, state health clinics, state refugee coordinator’s offices, medical providers, and other relevant service providers
* Participate in meetings on the national, state, and local levels, including those with services of stakeholders, other VOLAGS, and colleague agencies.
* Record clients’ progress in case files and master trackers, including compliance, job offers, placements, job retention, public assistance usage, follow\-up on placements, and possibilities of upgrades.
* Address emergency situations as they arise and mediate conflict as necessary

  


Qualifications:
*Education:** Bachelor's degree in social work, human services, sociology, psychology, public administration, public health, or a related field or equivalent experience in lieu of degree.

 *Experience:** Minimum 6 years of previous work experience in refugee or immigrant\-related services.
* Minimum 2 years of previous demonstrated work experience supervising others.
* Experience in a local resettlement affiliate or a national office of a resettlement agency (preferred)
* Experience in social services or nonprofit sectors (preferred).

 *Skills:*
* Strong interpersonal and diplomacy skills; ability to work collaboratively and effectively with partners and teams;
* Strong attention to detail a must
* Ability to always conduct oneself in a professional and courteous manner to represent the professional and institutional interests of CWS;
* Strong knowledge and experience in working with Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and database software is essential;
* Strong writing skills are required.
* The ability to work in a multi\-cultural environment is required.

  


Benefits : CWS offers a competitive benefits package that includes: \- 403 (b) Retirement Plan \- Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance \- Generous Paid Time Off (18 Paid Days Off; 24 Days after 2 Years) \- 14 Official Holidays \- 12 Sick Days Off (Accrued monthly) \- Life Insurance and AD\&D \- Long Term and Short\-Term Disability \- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) \- Health Savings Account \- Flexible Spending Accounts

new_jobs.title: Life Sciences - Reinvention Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
We are:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
* This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI\-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

  

The Work:

* Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy \& Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
* Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
* Leverage AI\-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
* Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
* Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast\-moving transformation engagement

  

You are:


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.


  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

  

* Program or project management at a top\-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi\-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
* A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Strong executive\-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision\-ready materials.
* Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

  

Preferred skills/experience:

  

* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMP, Agile/Scrum (CSM, SAFe), or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience managing AI\-enabled transformation programs or enterprise change initiatives in Life Sciences.
* Familiarity with AI agent orchestration tools for program reporting, status automation, or backlog management.
* Track record at a top\-tier consulting firm managing large\-scale transformation program delivery across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. new_jobs.description:
**Job ID:** 17287
**Business Unit:** MTA Headquarters
**Location:** New York, NY, United States
**Regular/Temporary:** Regular
**Department:** Supplier Management
**Date Posted:** Sep 22, 2026
**Description**


**JOB TITLE:**  

Procurement Manager (TC) **DEPT/DIV:**  

Procurement **SUPERVISOR:**Director of Procurement **WORK LOCATION:**  

333 West 34th Street, New York, NY 10001 **HOURS OF WORK:**  

8:00 am \- 4:30 pm (7\.5 hours/day, or as required) **FULL/PART\-TIME**  

FULL **SALARY RANGE:**  

$103,876 \- $115,418 **DEADLINE:**  

Until filled  


This position is eligible for telework, which is currently one day per week. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.

**Opening:**


The Metropolitan Transportation Authority is North America's largest transportation network, serving a population of 15\.3 million people across a 5,000\-square\-mile travel area surrounding New York City, Long Island, southeastern New York State, and Connecticut. The MTA network comprises the nation’s largest bus fleet and more subway and commuter rail cars than all other U.S. transit systems combined. MTA strives to provide a safe and reliable commute, excellent customer service, and rewarding opportunities.

**Job Summary****:**


Manages a team responsible for purchasing and the processing of requisitions for specified categories, typically for low to mid\-level requirements leveraging non\-RFP market strategies. Manages performance measurements, analysis, and tracking of target achievements for the Transactional Procurement team tasked with addressing stakeholder demand across all Agencies. Delegates workload as appropriate to team members and serves as the ultimate escalation path for MTA stakeholders within Transactional Procurement. Responsible for group recruiting, staff development, and performance appraisal.


**Responsibilities:**

* Manages a team responsible for processing requisitions using non\-RFP market strategies for goods and services not owned by Category Management or Sourcing.
* Leverages approved buying channel strategies and directs team accordingly to ensure optimal value capture from defined processes.
* Helps to define goals for the team, provides input to plans to achieve strategic targets, monitors progress of respective team, and adjusts plan to ensure goals are achieved.
* Ensures the observance of compliance with standards, policies, and procedures, including contributing to the development of purchasing standards and procedures.
* Ensures purchasing competitiveness at an Agency level.
* Participates in supplier performance reviews to improve or maintain timely and issue\-free delivery of products and services.
* Manages critical business relationships with external suppliers and business stakeholders, including policy interpretation and guidance to stakeholders and contractors.
* Manages issue escalations for related Transactional Procurement activities.
* Collaborates with the Legal Department regarding legal and contractual issues and/or litigation by providing information, documentation, and depositions, as required.
* Prepares materials for Federal Triennial Audits, as required.
* Meets savings and value creation targets.
* Meets diversity spend targets for assigned scope.
* Achieves a high percentage of events planned versus executed, team operations excellence, and team competency improvement.
* Delegates assignments and monitors team progress, manages team to prioritize objectives and lead them to completion.
* Responsible for the recruiting, development, and performance appraisal of assigned staff.

 **Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:*** Supply chain management, bidding and sealed bidding processes, contract writing and administration.
* Knowledge of best practice procure\-to\-pay processes, related policies, procedures, and risks, with ability to apply understanding to daily work
* Collaboration skills with ability to build effective relationships, as well as influence peers, customers, business partners, and staff.
* Project management skills, ability to plan and track, remove barriers, manage change, resolve conflict, build consensus, and motivate team members across multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messages to the given audience and present information in a clear and concise manner.
* Strong prioritization and organization skills, with ability to multitask in a fast\-paced and challenging environment.
* Experience using ERP Purchasing applications and other procurement\-related software.
* Knowledge of government procurement requirements such as sealed bids, advertising requirements, and diversity spend targets.

 **Required Education and Experience:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in Supply Chain Management, Procurement and Contract Management, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in a Procurement function with a focus on commercial transaction procurement.

**Other Information**  

May need to work outside of normal work hours (i.e., evenings and weekends)


Travel may be required to other MTA locations or other external sites.


According to the New York State Public Officers Law \& the MTA Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the NYS Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the “Commission”).

**Equal Employment Opportunity**


MTA and its subsidiary and affiliated agencies are Equal Opportunity Employers, including those concerning veteran status and individuals with disabilities.


The MTA encourages qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, including military service members, to apply.

This position serves as an intermediate\-level Project Manager and coordinates Government, business, technical, security, vendor, and contractor stakeholders to manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, assets, documentation, compliance, and delivery performance.


The position is responsible for supporting the lifecycle management of hardware, software, licenses, and related IT assets, including inventory management, asset traceability, product cataloging, ownership and assignment, location and status tracking, vendor coordination, service\-request fulfillment, product authorization, and associated financial and operational processes.


In addition to IT Asset Management expertise, the successful candidate must bring substantive experience in at least one complementary IT delivery discipline: **Change \& Configuration Management, Business Analysis, or Quality Management**.


Working with the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), Federal Task Lead, project teams, vendors, and other stakeholders, the IT Asset Project Manager manages resources, risks, dependencies, and customer relationships and supports successful delivery in accordance with task order requirements, federal standards, and Department of the Interior (DOI) and Indian Affairs (IA) policies and procedures.

* Maintain full traceability of IT assets, including inventory status, product information, vendor information, asset location, assigned user, ownership, lifecycle status, and other required data.
* Support hardware, software, software license, and property\-management activities using approved automated and manual processes.
* Maintain accurate, complete, current, and auditable IT asset records within applicable systems, repositories, catalogs, and databases.
