new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Supply Chain, Google Beam
new_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with supply chain planning.
* Experience with hardware product development.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google Beam is a true\-to\-life new communication technology from Google that allows people to feel like they’re having real face\-to\-face conversations, no matter the distance. Powered by realistic state\-of\-the\-art 3D imaging and spatial audio and integrated with today’s leading remote video platforms, Google Beam enables you to be immersed in the moment, together. As a part of the Google Beam team, you'll work with incredible teammates across all major functions in a fast\-paced product\-oriented environment. Your contributions will have an impact on the future of communications with Google products. You will apply technology to solve that really important problem that we often want to be together and we can’t.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Implement communications standards across a portfolio of programs including executive and key partner communications.
* Establish a reliable and visible cadence for program reviews, decision\-making, prioritization, and resource stewardship (effective deployment of machine and people resources) whereby improvements such as efficiency and utilization gains are measurable and the impact can be felt organization wide.
* Lead a governance structure that drives effective executive decision\-making. Ensure governance structure effectively exposes and mitigates dependencies.
* Seek out and identify change management opportunities that increase program velocity and which affect multiple teams.
* Define/manage a program portfolio solving problems that target high business impact for the organization and product area.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - Energy (Estimating to Traveling)
new_jobs.description:
**Posting Title:** Assistant Project Manager \- Energy (Estimating to Traveling)
  

**Reports To:** Senior Project Manager  

**Location:** San Jose, CA \| Hybrid  

**Salary Range:** $97,500 to $128,000


This position primarily involves working on\-site at the project location or in office. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on the role and project timeline.


Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.

**WHO WE ARE**  

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

**THE ENERGY TEAM**  

Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**  

The vision for the Assistant Project Manager – Estimating to Traveling role will be to train with the Energy division’s Estimating team, with intent to convert to an onsite traveling Assistant Project Manager position.


During the Assistant Project Manager’s training period with the Energy division’s Estimating team, they will: work closely with the Preconstruction team, Project Managers, Purchasing, Engineering, and report to the Chief Estimator \- Energy. The Estimator will be responsible for developing and completing utility scale solar PV and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) estimates, including self\-perform and subcontracted scopes of work. Estimating includes RFP \& drawing package review, developing proposal level designs, quantity take\-off, material RFQ prep \& evaluation, and subcontractor RFQ prep \& evaluation.

* Lead team meetings and provide guidance to Project Engineers and Project Coordinators in partnership with the Project Manager and field team.
* Partners with scheduling department to gather all data required to populate CEI schedule.
* Identifies cost impacts associated with RFIs, submittals, and design changes and provides timely notification.
* Prices change orders consistently and in a timely manner for project manager review and approval.
* Manages close out documents.
* Coordinate commissioning activities w/ 3rd party. Tracks and follows up on open items.
* Maintain strong working partnerships with vendors and subcontractors. Coordinates accurate material releases on time and consistent with project documents. Track material releases, changes and coordinate delivery with construction schedule.

**ABOUT YOU**  

You bring innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project with prior experience supervising and/or providing guidance to others. You possess technical knowledge and communication skills, which are vital to an Assistant Project Manager’s success. You have experience providing in\-house support to Project Managers such as coordinating, tracking quantities complete for billing, and managing project activities and documentation. You bring a willingness to learn and are on the lookout for ways to improve existing processes.

* Serve as the go\-to person to help resolve any issues or potential problem areas.
* Actively thinks about new ways to improve or change processes. Brings innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project.
* Prior experience working on semi\-remote jobsites, supervising others. Renewables/Large Electrical/Data Center build experience highly desired.
* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.
* Experience with Accubid estimating software preferred.

new_jobs.title: Life Sciences - Reinvention Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
We are:


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. We are a talent\- and innovation\-led company with approximately 799,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries.

  

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.

  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

  

About the role:

* The Reinvention Program Manager is the operational backbone of the AI Transformation Office.
* This role keeps the program running with discipline, visibility, and momentum — managing communications, milestone tracking, portfolio reporting, and operating cadence across all workstreams.
* This is not a traditional PMO role — it is an AI\-enabled program manager who uses automation to do what once required a team.

  

The Work:

* Manage project communications, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting across all transformation workstreams — giving the Portfolio Strategy \& Value Lead the visibility needed to govern effectively
* Track budget actuals against plan, surface variances early, and support governance reporting to the client's transformation leadership
* Leverage AI\-powered project management tools and automation to streamline program operations — this role is expected to be a practitioner of the tools deployed
* Coordinate across Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators to maintain an integrated view of progress, dependencies, and risks
* Maintain the operating cadence: cadence calls, status reports, risk logs, and action tracking across a fast\-moving transformation engagement

  

You are:


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.


  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following areas:

  

* Program or project management at a top\-tier consulting firm or in a complex enterprise delivery environment, with demonstrated experience managing multi\-workstream programs from initiation through completion.
* A proven track record designing and maintaining program operating rhythms — including cadence calls, status reporting, risk logs, and budget tracking — for senior executive audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered project management and automation tools to improve program visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Strong executive\-ready written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program status into clear, decision\-ready materials.
* Experience coordinating across multidisciplinary teams including consultants, technologists, and change practitioners.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.

  

Preferred skills/experience:

  

* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMP, Agile/Scrum (CSM, SAFe), or equivalent program management certification.
* Experience managing AI\-enabled transformation programs or enterprise change initiatives in Life Sciences.
* Familiarity with AI agent orchestration tools for program reporting, status automation, or backlog management.
* Track record at a top\-tier consulting firm managing large\-scale transformation program delivery across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager III, AI Transformation, Google Cloud
new_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience in software engineering, technical solution development or product development.
Experience designing, building, and deploying AI models and intelligent agents.  
* 

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience driving internal tool adoption and executing structured change management strategies across large\-scale engineering teams.
* Experience partnering with engineering teams to rapidly iterate, prototype, deliver and debug software solutions.
* Domain expertise in agentic development (e.g., enterprise RAG systems, Large Language Model (LLM) guardrails, and context management frameworks).

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


In this role, you will drive an organizational transformation of program management by modernizing workflows, embedding AI at the core of our operations, and engineering AI first platforms.


Team’s strategic priorities include driving standardization of AI2 Program Data Corpus by building data\-capsules for all AI2 programs. Building connectivity between other AI investments including TeamLLM (Team data layer) and PVP (Resources data layer). Providing a rich operational and presentation layer for users on 007, Jetski, LLM extension etc. surfaces. Building autonomous agents, handling end to end program management for common use cases. Building a program execution data Oracle for al2, so that execution knowledge is accrued with every project AI2 ships, and becomes discoverable on will. Transforming Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and tools in meeting demands of the business execution in the agentic era.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $163000 \- $236000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead use\-case analysis and author Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) to translate user needs into technical specifications. Design agentic workflows and tool integrations, collaborating with Engineering to deliver high\-quality interfaces across surfaces that meet stringent performance standards.
* Establish deterministic evaluation metrics to benchmark and assess tool quality, analyze results, and resolve performance issues. Partner directly with end users to debug quality concerns.
* Coordinate product testing and phased launches for new AI capabilities. Oversee platform access controls and perform adversarial testing to evaluate agent failure modes, such as API payload errors and execution timeouts.
* Develop change management playbooks and direct targeted onboarding initiatives to drive adoption.
* Identify, communicate, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders within one or more teams to drive impact and work toward mutual goals. Build, maintain and enhance business, operational, and management dashboards.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

**Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE \- Digital Native Business**
=============================================================


**About the Team**
------------------


The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C\-suite\-sponsored, high\-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering *outcomes*, not just a platform.


You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production\-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."


**Role Description**
--------------------


As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi\-million\-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.


You will build C\-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.


This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands\-on delivery mindset.


**The impact you will have**
----------------------------


* **C\-Suite Scoping \& Value Definition:** Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M\+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands\-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* **Technical Solution Leadership** **\& Delivery:** Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C\-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure\-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* **Solution Launch \& Landing:** Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. **What we look for**
--------------------


* **Executive Presence \& Communication:** You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* **Product Judgment \& Delivery:** You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* **Technical Fluency \& Architecture Judgment:** You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade\-offs, and pressure\-test technical decisions.
* **Hands\-on Technical Ability:** You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* **Relevant Experience:** Typically 7\+ years of experience delivering complex, customer\-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high\-growth technology company, forward\-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25\-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Software
new_jobs.description:
### **About Mind:**


Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real\-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands\-on with the physical world every day \- and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

  

### **About the team and the role:**


Program Management at Mind is an operational catalyst. We own outcomes, drive the trade\-offs that keep engineering moving, and set the metabolic rate of the teams we partner with — clearing roadblocks, closing stalled decisions, carrying risk upward, and protecting the focus engineers need to build. As a Software Program Manager you will own the integrated program plan across all of software and build the practice itself: how teams define their own milestones and commit to org\-level ones, how we know week over week whether we are on or off track, and how problems surface early enough that we can still do something about them. You will partner directly with hardware program management so that software and hardware roll up into one program picture rather than two competing ones.

**Responsibilities:**

* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Own the software program plan end to end — from roadmap planning through implementation, integration, validation, and release to the fleet — and own the functional outcome, not just the schedule.
* **Program Practice Design:** Establish how software program management works at Mind: the planning rhythm that connects team\-level work to org\-level milestones, what qualifies as a milestone, what "done" means at each one, and the artifacts that support both the individual engineer and leadership in prioritization and decision making.
* **Milestone Planning:** Build software plans that align with org\-level milestones, including clear definitions of what “done” means at each step.
* **Metric Tracking:** Monitor and report on key program metrics, and communicate status, blockers, and risks to leadership.
* **Progress Tracking \& Status Integrity:** Build the tracking layer that answers whether we are on or off track, drawn from the systems teams already work in.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and escalate technical, dependency, and resourcing risks early, and and drive them to resolution.
* **Technical / Business Judgment:** Engage directly in architecture and design discussions at a depth sufficient to stress\-test engineering estimates and pressure\-test readiness. Drive decisions at that level with understanding of the impacts to our business goals.

### **Requirements:**

* **Educational Background:** Bachelor's degree in engineering (software / computer science preferred), or equivalent experience.
* **Industry Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in technical program management for software products, ideally in robotics, autonomous systems, or another domain where software ships against hardware and real\-world deployment constraints.
* **Proven Track Record:** Demonstrated success taking software from early development through release and sustained operation.
* **Technical Depth:** Strong software fundamentals with the ability to engage meaningfully in architecture, planning, and systems integration discussions.
* **System Complexity:** Experience managing programs spanning multiple interdependent software domains along with their dependencies on hardware revisions and the availability of test hardware.
* **Execution \& Ownership:** High sense of urgency, comfortable with ambiguity, and driven by an "engineering curiosity" to understand how the entire system works.

The application window will be open until at least October 6, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.


In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:

  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  


Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in management consulting, sales operations, business strategy, or corporate advisory role.
* 3 years of experience working with executive stakeholders.
* Experience using SQL or data analytics tools deliver insights and recommendations.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience creating complex data sets, data modeling, and reporting.
* 2 years of experience in advertising, consultative sales, business development, or a digital media environment.
* Experience in consumer internet and media industries.
* Experience with controlled experiments, causal studies, and communicating technical results to non\-technical audiences.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Business Strategy \& Operations organization provides business critical insights using analytics, ensures cross functional alignment of goals and execution, and helps teams drive strategic partnerships and new initiatives forward. We stay focused on aligning the highest\-level company priorities with effective day\-to\-day operations, and help evolve early stage ideas into future\-growth initiatives.



As a part of The YouTube Ads Go\-to\-Market (GTM) Strategy and Operations team, you will bridge the gap between YouTube Ads product teams and regional commercialization teams. Your mission is to fuel growth by scaling innovation to customers, creators, and viewers by translating global market needs into meaningful product solutions.


The Go\-to\-Market Operations (GtM) team ensures Google's complex and ever\-evolving Ads business runs smoothly. We are instrumental in setting go\-to\-market strategy, and ensuring flawless execution and operations against the strategy. We have teams embedded in each of the major Ads business areas as well as global teams that work across the business areas. Team members are analytical and strategic, with a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $124000 \- $177000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive hypothesis\-driven business strategy for YouTube products across users, partners, and creators.
* Develop GTM plans, execute communication documents, and lead experiments/trusted tester programs.
* Establish operational excellence by setting and tracking Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and driving annual business planning.
* Gather market intelligence and conduct analyses and modeling to develop insights and SQL\-based dashboards.
* Build actionable plans and roadmaps and align cross\-functional stakeholders to drive successful implementation of change initiatives.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Compensation Range:**


$103,500\.00 \- $117,000\.00  


Plus Incentive Bonus based on Performance **Location:**


1301 S Lamar Blvd , Austin, Texas, 78704  


Alamo Drafthouse is looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to serve as the company's lead data expert, building the reporting and data infrastructure that lets Operations, Marketing, Development, and Finance trust the numbers they're making decisions on.  

  

This role reports directly to the VP of Finance and partners closely with Analytics Engineering within the IT team. The position works within a dbt\-centric analytics stack (Snowflake, dbt, Omni) where every change to shared data models ships through Git and a pull request review, following software engineering best practices. Day\-to\-day work sits closer to SQL \+ dbt \+ Git than to drag\-and\-drop dashboard building. You'll be equally responsible for hands\-on technical work and for building consensus across departments on what a metric means and which system is the source of truth for it.**WHAT WE OFFER**

* A fun workplace where you can be yourself and do awesome work!
* Free movies \& food
* Paid time off
* Competitive pay
* Flexible scheduling
* Medical, dental, vision, FSA, HSA, and voluntary benefits are available for **all full\-time and part\-time teammates**

**OUR MISSION:**

  

To Ensure EVERY Guest and Teammate Has An AWESOME Experience And Is EXCITED To Come Back

 **LOCATION:** *This is a* ***HYBRID*** *position; we are actively prioritizing candidates based in or near* ***Austin, TX (preferred) OR Los Angeles, CA.***

 **CORE ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain BI reports, dashboards, and datasets covering multi\-unit performance across our theaters — box office, food \& beverage, marketing performance, labor, inventory, and guest experience metrics.
* Translate evolving, cross\-functional business requirements from Operations, Marketing, Development, and Finance into clear, well\-scoped data visualizations.
* Build and optimize data models within our dbt transformation layer, and drive continuous improvement in reporting processes.
* Establish and maintain a shared metrics glossary and consistent data definitions across departments.
* Act as the escalation point for complex BI, data modeling, and reconciliation issues.
* Foster data democratization across the organization, including training and documentation so business users adopt self\-service tools confidently.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

***Must Haves***

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence.
* *Nice to Haves, but not a must*
* Direct hands\-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse platform such as BigQuery or Redshift).
* Direct hands\-on experience with Omni specifically.
* Python or another object\-oriented programming language.
* Experience supporting a multi\-unit, brick\-and\-mortar business model (i.e. cinema, restaurants, hotels, retail, grocery, or similar).
* Strong, daily\-use SQL skills, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries against large, multi\-source datasets.
* Hands\-on experience with dbt (or a comparable SQL\-based transformation framework), including comfort working within a large, shared model codebase.
* Working proficiency with Git/GitHub and a pull\-request\-based code review workflow.
* Experience building semantic models and dashboards in a modern BI platform (e.g., Omni, Looker/LookML, or similar).
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

 ***Nice to Haves, but not a must***

* Direct hands\-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse platform such as BigQuery or Redshift).
* Direct hands\-on experience with Omni specifically.
* Python or another object\-oriented programming language.

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Lifting and moving up to 30lbs
* Sitting for long periods of time

**OUR CORE VALUES:**

 **DO THE RIGHT THING**  

We strive to be a force of good in our company, in our industry and in the world. We stand up for our beliefs even when it is hard. We start from a place of kindness.  

  

**FOSTER COMMUNITY**  

We value what is unique about each other and celebrate our differences. We treat each other with respect, support each other’s passions, and help each other grow. We welcome healthy debate but don’t tolerate intolerance. We take this commitment outside our 4 walls, creating neighborhood theaters that are deeply tied to the local community.  

  

**BOLDLY GO**  

Like the crew of the Starship Enterprise™, we seek out new experiences and pursue innovation in all of our work. We take risks and chart new territory. We learn from our mistakes and continuously improve.  

  

**GIVE A SH!T**  

We are passionate about creating awesome experiences. We obsess over every detail and take pride in our work because we know it makes all the difference to our guests and our teammates. Our pursuit of excellence drives us to do our best.

**Company**: Alamo Drafthouse Cinema
